theorem sel_run (y : List Bool) : ∀ m (hm : m < nbits M), m ≤ y.length →
    (tabTM M).tm.runFrom ((tabTM M).tm.initCfg y) m =
      acfg M (some (.sel ⟨m, hm⟩ (selPart M y m))) (fpos y (m + 1)) bl bl bl 0 0 0 [] := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro hm _
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, init_eq]
    congr
  | succ m ih =>
    intro hm hy
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega) (by omega), acfg_step,
      inputSymbol_fpos _ (by omega) (by omega) rfl]
    have hget : y[m + 1 - 1]? = some (y[m]'(by omega)) := by
      simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (show m < y.length by omega)]
    rw [hget]
    simp only [tabTr, dif_pos hm]
    rw [tact_idle_apply, moveInputPos_fpos (by omega)]
    simp only [idle_apply, wr_none, SignType.coe_zero, add_zero, List.append_nil, Option.toList]
    rw [selPart_succ M y m (by omega) (by omega)]

/-- **Selector bits read**: on an input with at least `nbits` symbols, after `nbits`
steps the machine starts reading the first field, with the first `nbits` input bits in
its control.

**Proof sketch.** Run `nbits - 1` steps by `sel_run`, then the last selector bit moves to
the first field state; the accumulated bits are all of `y`'s first `nbits` bits. -/

theorem field_some {y : List Bool} (f : Bool) (bits : Fin (nbits M) → Bool) :
    ∀ (rest : List Bool) (p : ℕ) (wC wO w r : List Bool), 1 ≤ p → y.drop (p - 1) = rest →
      readField rest = some (w, r) →
      (tabTM M).tm.runFrom (pcfg M (.fA f bits) (fpos y p) [] wC wO) (2 * w.length + 2) =
        pcfg M (if f then .cpy bits else .fA true bits) (fpos y (p + 2 * w.length + 2)) []
          (if f then wC else wC ++ w) (if f then wO ++ w else wO)
  | b :: true :: r', p, wC, wO, w, r, h1, hd, hr => by
    simp only [readField, Option.map_eq_some_iff] at hr
    obtain ⟨⟨w', r''⟩, hw', he⟩ := hr
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at he
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := he
    have hl : p - 1 + 2 ≤ y.length := by
      have := congrArg List.length hd; simp at this; omega
    have r0 : y[p - 1]? = some b := by simpa using getElem?_of_drop hd 0
    have r1 : y[p + 1 - 1]? = some true := by
      have := getElem?_of_drop hd 1; rw [show p - 1 + 1 = p + 1 - 1 by omega] at this; simpa using this
    have hd' : y.drop (p + 2 - 1) = r' := by
      rw [show p + 2 - 1 = (p - 1) + 2 by omega, ← List.drop_drop, hd]; rfl
    have ih := field_some f bits r' (p + 2) (if f then wC else wC ++ [b])
      (if f then wO ++ [b] else wO) w' r'' (by omega) hd' hw'
    rw [show 2 * (b :: w').length + 2 = (2 * w'.length + 2) + 1 + 1 by simp; ring,
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step,
      pcfg_fA M f bits p h1 (by omega) b r0,
      pcfg_fB_true M f b bits (p + 1) (by omega) (by omega) r1]
    rw [show p + 1 + 1 = p + 2 by omega, ih,
      show p + 2 + 2 * w'.length + 2 = p + 2 * (b :: w').length + 2 by simp; ring]
    cases f <;> simp
  | e :: false :: r', p, wC, wO, w, r, h1, hd, hr => by
    simp only [readField, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hr
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hr
    have hl : p - 1 + 2 ≤ y.length := by
      have := congrArg List.length hd; simp at this; omega
    have r0 : y[p - 1]? = some e := by simpa using getElem?_of_drop hd 0
    have r1 : y[p + 1 - 1]? = some false := by
      have := getElem?_of_drop hd 1; rw [show p - 1 + 1 = p + 1 - 1 by omega] at this; simpa using this
    rw [show 2 * ([] : List Bool).length + 2 = 0 + 1 + 1 by rfl,
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step,
      pcfg_fA M f bits p h1 (by omega) e r0,
      pcfg_fB_false M f e bits (p + 1) (by omega) (by omega) r1, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    cases f <;> simp
  | [], _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hr => by simp [readField] at hr
  | [_], _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hr => by simp [readField] at hr

/-- A halted rejection persists. -/

theorem cpy_run {y : List Bool} (bits : Fin (nbits M) → Bool) :
    ∀ (rest : List Bool) (p : ℕ) (wX wC wO : List Bool), 1 ≤ p →
      p + rest.length = y.length + 1 → y.drop (p - 1) = rest →
      (tabTM M).tm.runFrom (pcfg M (.cpy bits) (fpos y p) wX wC wO) (rest.length + 1) =
        acfg M (some (.rewX bits)) (fpos y (y.length + 1)) (bufferTape (wX ++ rest))
          (bufferTape wC) (bufferTape wO) ((wX ++ rest).length - 1) wC.length wO.length []
  | [], p, wX, wC, wO, h1, hlen, hd => by
    have r0 : y[p - 1]? = none := by simpa using getElem?_of_drop hd 0
    simp only [List.length_nil] at hlen
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, List.length_nil, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero,
      pcfg_step M _ p h1 (by omega), r0]
    simp only [tabTr]
    rw [pcfg, tact_idle_apply]
    simp only [one_0_0, one_0_1, one_0_2, wr_none, SignType.coe_zero, add_zero, List.append_nil,
      Option.toList, moveInputPos_zero]
    congr 1
    ext; simp [fpos]; omega
  | b :: r, p, wX, wC, wO, h1, hlen, hd => by
    have r0 : y[p - 1]? = some b := by simpa using getElem?_of_drop hd 0
    have hd' : y.drop (p + 1 - 1) = r := by
      rw [show p + 1 - 1 = (p - 1) + 1 by omega, ← List.drop_drop, hd]; rfl
    simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen ⊢
    have hstep : (tabTM M).tm.step (pcfg M (.cpy bits) (fpos y p) wX wC wO) =
        pcfg M (.cpy bits) (fpos y (p + 1)) (wX ++ [b]) wC wO := by
      rw [pcfg_step M _ p h1 (by omega), r0]
      simp only [tabTr]
      rw [pcfg, tact_idle_apply, moveInputPos_fpos (by omega)]
      simp [pcfg, bufferTape_write]
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, hstep,
      cpy_run bits r (p + 1) (wX ++ [b]) wC wO (by omega) (by omega) hd']
    simp

/-- Reading auxiliary tape `0` in block form. -/
@[simp] theorem aux_read0 {α : Type} (f : Fin M.k → α) (a b c : α) :
    (Fin.addCases f ![a, b, c] : Fin (M.k + 3) → α) (Fin.natAdd M.k 0) = a := by
  simp [Fin.addCases_right]
/-- Reading auxiliary tape `1` in block form. -/
@[simp] theorem aux_read1 {α : Type} (f : Fin M.k → α) (a b c : α) :
    (Fin.addCases f ![a, b, c] : Fin (M.k + 3) → α) (Fin.natAdd M.k 1) = b := by
  simp [Fin.addCases_right]
/-- Reading auxiliary tape `2` in block form. -/
@[simp] theorem aux_read2 {α : Type} (f : Fin M.k → α) (a b c : α) :
    (Fin.addCases f ![a, b, c] : Fin (M.k + 3) → α) (Fin.natAdd M.k 2) = c := by

/-- A stored word read at cell `j - 1` for `1 ≤ j ≤ |w|`. -/

theorem abs_workTapePos_le (w : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (τ : Fin M.k) :
    |(cfgAt M w t).workTapePos τ| ≤ t := by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [cfgAt, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, Cfg.init]
  | succ t ih =>
    have h := MultiTapeTM.workTapePos_step_le (tm := M.tm) (cfgAt M w t) τ
    simp only [cfgAt, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step'] at h ih ⊢
    rw [abs_le] at h ih ⊢
    push_cast
    constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2, ih.1, ih.2]

/-- The input symbol under the head, as a function of the head position. -/

private lemma enumCont_undo_run (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c₀ : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (t : ℕ)
    (hlive : ∀ j < t, ¬(M.tm.runFrom c₀ j).Halted) :
    (enumCont_undoTM M.k).tm.runFrom
      (enumCont_undoCfg (M.tm.runFrom c₀ t) (enumCont_history M.tm c₀ t) p) (2 * t + 1) =
      enumCont_undoResult c₀ p := by
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    simpa only [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_add, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero,
      enumCont_history, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one]
      using enumCont_undo_empty c₀ p
  | succ t ih =>
    have hs : (M.tm.runFrom c₀ t).state ≠ none := hlive t (by omega)
    cases hq : (M.tm.runFrom c₀ t).state with
    | none => exact False.elim (hs hq)
    | some q =>
      have he : 2 * (t + 1) + 1 = 2 + (2 * t + 1) := by omega
      let c := M.tm.runFrom c₀ t
      let a := M.tm.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols
      have hsrun : M.tm.runFrom c₀ (t + 1) = a.apply c := by
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
        simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hq]
        rfl
      have hhist : enumCont_history M.tm c₀ (t + 1) =
          enumCont_history M.tm c₀ t ++ [(c.workTapeSymbols, fun i => (a.workTapes i).2)] := by
        simp only [enumCont_history, hq]
        rfl
      have htwo : (enumCont_undoTM M.k).tm.runFrom
          (enumCont_undoCfg (a.apply c)
            (enumCont_history M.tm c₀ t ++ [(c.workTapeSymbols, fun i => (a.workTapes i).2)]) p) 2 =
          enumCont_undoCfg c (enumCont_history M.tm c₀ t) p := by
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one, enumCont_undo_back, enumCont_undo_write]
      rw [hsrun, hhist, he, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, htwo]
      exact ih (fun j hj => hlive j (by omega))

/-- Any known halted endpoint is reached at the first halting time, with a
live source at every earlier time. The bound is never increased. -/

private theorem xr_runFrom_fixed {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
    (d : Cfg k Bool S x) (hd : tm.step d = d) (n : ℕ) : tm.runFrom d n = d := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero
  | succ n ih => rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih, hd]

/-- Two steps of a run. -/

private theorem xr_fwd_run {K : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM K Bool xr_St) (r : Fin K)
    (hsome : ∀ inp w s, w r = some s →
      tm.tr .run inp w = xr_act (xr_mv1 r none SignType.pos) (some .run))
    (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ (o : ℤ) (d : Cfg K Bool xr_St x), d.state = some .run → d.workTapePos r = o →
      (∀ i : ℕ, i < m → d.workTapes r (o + i) ≠ none) →
      tm.runFrom d m =
        ⟨some .run, d.inputPos, d.workTapes, Function.update d.workTapePos r (o + m),
          d.output⟩ := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro o d hd hpos _
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · exact hd
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · funext i
      dsimp only
      by_cases hi : i = r
      · rw [hi, Function.update_self, hpos]
        simp
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hi]
    · rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    intro o d hd hpos hcells
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp (hcells 0 (by omega))
    have hread : d.workTapeSymbols r = some s := by
      rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq, hpos]
      simpa using hs
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hd, hsome _ _ s hread,
      xr_mv1_apply_none, hpos, xr_cast_pos]
    rw [ih (o + 1) _ rfl (by dsimp only; rw [Function.update_self]) ?_]
    · dsimp only
      rw [Function.update_idem]
      congr 2
      push_cast
      ring
    · intro i hi
      dsimp only
      have := hcells (i + 1) (by omega)
      push_cast at this ⊢
      convert this using 2
      ring

/-- **The rewind**: one step left, then left while reading a symbol, then one step right at the
blank. -/

private theorem xr_pass_fwd {K : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (j r : Fin K) (hjr : j ≠ r) (dir : SignType)
    (u : List Bool) (d : Cfg K Bool xr_St x) (hd : d.state = some .run)
    (hr : d.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape u) (hpos : d.workTapePos r = 0) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : m ≤ u.length) :
    ∃ f : ℤ → Option Bool,
      (xr_passTM K j r dir).runFrom d m =
        ⟨some .run, d.inputPos, Function.update d.workTapes j f,
          fun i => if i = j then d.workTapePos j + m * (dir : ℤ)
            else if i = r then (m : ℤ) else d.workTapePos i, d.output⟩ ∧
      (∀ p : ℤ, (∃ i : ℕ, i < m ∧ p = d.workTapePos j + i * (dir : ℤ)) → f p = none) ∧
      (∀ p : ℤ, (∀ i : ℕ, i < m → p ≠ d.workTapePos j + i * (dir : ℤ)) →
        f p = d.workTapes j p) := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨d.workTapes j, ?_, fun p ⟨i, hi, _⟩ => absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero i), fun p _ => rfl⟩
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · exact hd
    · rfl
    · exact (Function.update_eq_self _ _).symm
    · funext i
      dsimp only
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · rw [if_pos hij, hij]
        simp
      · rw [if_neg hij]
        by_cases hir : i = r
        · rw [if_pos hir, hir, hpos]
          simp
        · rw [if_neg hir]
    · rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    obtain ⟨f, hrun, hblank, hkeep⟩ := ih (by omega)
    have hread : (⟨some .run, d.inputPos, Function.update d.workTapes j f,
        fun i => if i = j then d.workTapePos j + m * (dir : ℤ)
          else if i = r then (m : ℤ) else d.workTapePos i, d.output⟩ :
        Cfg K Bool xr_St x).workTapeSymbols r = some (u[m]'(by omega)) := by
      rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
      dsimp only
      rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hjr), if_pos rfl, Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hjr), hr,
        FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)]
    refine ⟨Function.update f (d.workTapePos j + m * (dir : ℤ)) none, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', hrun, MultiTapeTM.step_of_some rfl,
        show (xr_passTM K j r dir).tr .run _ _ =
          xr_act (xr_mv2 j r (some none) dir SignType.pos) (some .run) by
            simp only [xr_passTM]
            rw [hread],
        xr_mv2_apply j r hjr]
      dsimp only
      simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_idem, Option.getD_some,
        if_neg (Ne.symm hjr), xr_cast_pos, ite_true]
      congr 1
      funext i
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · simp only [if_pos hij]
        push_cast
        ring
      · by_cases hir : i = r
        · simp only [if_neg hij, if_pos hir]
          push_cast
          ring
        · simp only [if_neg hij, if_neg hir]
    · rintro p ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      by_cases hp : d.workTapePos j + i * (dir : ℤ) = d.workTapePos j + m * (dir : ℤ)
      · rw [hp, Function.update_self]
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hp]
        refine hblank _ ⟨i, ?_, rfl⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hi with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd (by rw [h]) hp
    · intro p hp
      rw [Function.update_of_ne (hp m (by omega))]
      exact hkeep p (fun i hi => hp i (by omega))

/-- **The pass's contract.** From the origin of the ruler word `u`, `2|u| + 2` steps move head `j`
by `|u|` cells along `dir`, blank the `|u| + 1` cells it visited, return the ruler head to `0`,
change nothing else, and stop at `done true`.

**Proof sketch.** `xr_pass_fwd` gives the first `|u|` steps: head `j` moves `|u|` cells along
`dir`, blanking each cell it leaves, while the ruler head walks over `u`. At the ruler's right
blank one step blanks the last visited cell and turns the ruler head back, and `xr_back_run`
returns it to `0` in `|u| + 1` steps. The visited cells are `pos + i·dir` for `i ≤ |u|`; every
other cell keeps its symbol. -/

private theorem nf_leaf_prefix (N : FinNDTM Bool) (j : Option (Fin N.k)) {x : List Bool}
    (d : Cfg 2 Bool (nf_LeafSt N) x) (rec : Fin (2 * N.k + 4) → Bool) (ctl : nf_Control N)
    (hst : d.state = some (.read ((0, fun _ => none), ctl)))
    (hA : ∀ p : Fin (2 * N.k + 4), d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + (p.val : ℤ)) = some (rec p)) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m < 2 * N.k + 4), (nf_leaf N j).runFrom d m = { d with
      state := some (.read ((List.ofFn fun i : Fin m => rec ⟨i.val, by omega⟩).foldl
        (nf_sweepStep N) ((0, fun _ => none), ctl)))
      workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + m) }
  | 0, _ => by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · rw [hst]
      rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · funext i
      show d.workTapePos i = Function.update d.workTapePos 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)) i
      rw [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, Function.update_eq_self]
    · rfl
  | m + 1, hm => by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', nf_leaf_prefix N j d rec ctl hst hA m (by omega)]
    have hp := nf_sweep_prefix N rec ctl m (by omega)
    have hm1 : ((List.ofFn fun i : Fin m => rec ⟨i.val, by omega⟩).foldl
        (nf_sweepStep N) ((0, fun _ => none), ctl)).1.1.val = m := by rw [hp]
    have hsym : ({ d with
        state := some (.read ((List.ofFn fun i : Fin m => rec ⟨i.val, by omega⟩).foldl
          (nf_sweepStep N) ((0, fun _ => none), ctl)))
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + m) } :
          Cfg 2 Bool (nf_LeafSt N) x).workTapeSymbols 0 = some (rec ⟨m, by omega⟩) := by
      rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
      show d.workTapes 0 (Function.update d.workTapePos 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + m) 0) = _
      rw [Function.update_self]
      exact hA ⟨m, by omega⟩
    rw [step_of_tapeAction_move (nf_leaf N j) _ (q := .read _) 0 0 1 rfl (by
      simp only [nf_leaf]
      rw [if_neg (by rw [hm1]; omega), hsym, Option.getD_some])]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · show some (nf_LeafSt.read (nf_sweepStep N _ _)) = some (nf_LeafSt.read
        ((List.ofFn fun i : Fin (m + 1) => rec ⟨i.val, by omega⟩).foldl
          (nf_sweepStep N) ((0, fun _ => none), ctl)))
      rw [List.ofFn_succ_last, List.foldl_concat]
      simp only [Fin.coe_castSucc, Fin.val_last, hp]
    · exact moveInputPos_zero _
    · rfl
    · funext i
      dsimp only
      by_cases hi : i = 0
      · subst hi
        rw [Function.update_self, Function.update_self, Function.update_self, SignType.coe_one]
        push_cast
        ring
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hi, Function.update_of_ne hi, Function.update_of_ne hi]
    · rfl

/-- **The replay leaf at a record's last bit.** From a record boundary, with the record on tape `0`
from its head, every instance is at no exit for the record's first `2k + 4` steps; after `2k + 3`
of them it reads the last bit with the parser at its last position, the record's array complete
once that bit is stored, and the parser's step there the completion rule.

**Proof sketch.** The read of the first `2k + 3` bits, then the parser's last-position facts. -/

private theorem nf_leaf_block (N : FinNDTM Bool) (t : Fin N.k) {x : List Bool}
    (e : Cfg 2 Bool (nf_LeafSt N) x) (σ : nf_SweepState N) (claim n : Option Bool)
    (mv : SignType) (last : Bool) (hst : e.state = some (.blk₁ σ claim n mv last)) :
    (∀ u < 2, ∀ s, ((nf_leaf N (some t)).runFrom e u).state = some s →
      nf_leafExit N s = none) ∧
    (nf_blockDecode (e.workTapes 1 (e.workTapePos 1)) (e.workTapes 1 (e.workTapePos 1 + 1)) =
        claim → last = true →
      (nf_leaf N (some t)).runFrom e 2 = { e with
        state := some .pass
        workTapes :=
          Function.update e.workTapes 1 (nf_blockWrite (e.workTapes 1) (e.workTapePos 1) n)
        workTapePos := Function.update e.workTapePos 1 (e.workTapePos 1 + 1) }) ∧
    (nf_blockDecode (e.workTapes 1 (e.workTapePos 1)) (e.workTapes 1 (e.workTapePos 1 + 1)) =
        claim → last = false →
      (∀ u < 4, ∀ s, ((nf_leaf N (some t)).runFrom e u).state = some s →
        nf_leafExit N s = none) ∧
      (nf_leaf N (some t)).runFrom e 4 = { e with
        state := some (.read σ)
        workTapes :=
          Function.update e.workTapes 1 (nf_blockWrite (e.workTapes 1) (e.workTapePos 1) n)
        workTapePos := Function.update e.workTapePos 1 (e.workTapePos 1 + 2 * (mv : ℤ)) }) ∧
    (nf_blockDecode (e.workTapes 1 (e.workTapePos 1)) (e.workTapes 1 (e.workTapePos 1 + 1)) ≠
        claim → ((nf_leaf N (some t)).runFrom e 2).state = some .rej) := by
  set b := e.workTapePos 1 with hb
  -- the first block step: read the first cell, write the content's first bit, move right
  set e₁ : Cfg 2 Bool (nf_LeafSt N) x := { e with
      state := some (.blk₂ σ claim n mv last (e.workTapes 1 b))
      inputPos := moveInputPos e.inputPos 0
      workTapes := Function.update e.workTapes 1
        (Function.update (e.workTapes 1) (e.workTapePos 1) (some n.isSome))
      workTapePos := Function.update e.workTapePos 1 (e.workTapePos 1 + 1) } with he₁
  have h1 : (nf_leaf N (some t)).runFrom e 1 = e₁ := by
    rw [show (1 : ℕ) = 0 + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one,
      step_of_tapeAction_write (nf_leaf N (some t)) e (q := .blk₁ σ claim n mv last) 1 0
        (some n.isSome) 1 hst rfl, SignType.coe_one, Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
  have hsym1 : e₁.workTapeSymbols 1 = e.workTapes 1 (b + 1) := by
    rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
    show Function.update e.workTapes 1
      (Function.update (e.workTapes 1) (e.workTapePos 1) (some n.isSome)) 1
      (Function.update e.workTapePos 1 (e.workTapePos 1 + 1) 1) = _
    rw [Function.update_self, Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne (by omega)]
  have hpre : ∀ u < 2, ∀ s, ((nf_leaf N (some t)).runFrom e u).state = some s →
      nf_leafExit N s = none := by
    intro u hu s hs
    rcases (by omega : u = 0 ∨ u = 1) with rfl | rfl
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hst] at hs
      cases hs
      rfl
    · rw [h1] at hs
      cases hs
      rfl
  have hw2 : ∀ (q' : nf_LeafSt N) (m : SignType) (v : Bool),
      (nf_leaf N (some t)).tr (.blk₂ σ claim n mv last (e.workTapes 1 b)) e₁.inputSymbol
        e₁.workTapeSymbols = tapeAction 1 0 (some (some v)) m q' →
      (nf_leaf N (some t)).runFrom e 2 = { e₁ with
        state := some q'
        inputPos := moveInputPos e₁.inputPos 0
        workTapes := Function.update e₁.workTapes 1
          (Function.update (e₁.workTapes 1) (e₁.workTapePos 1) (some v))
        workTapePos := Function.update e₁.workTapePos 1 (e₁.workTapePos 1 + m) } := by
    intro q' m v htr
    have e2 : (nf_leaf N (some t)).runFrom e 2 =
        (nf_leaf N (some t)).step ((nf_leaf N (some t)).runFrom e 1) :=
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step'
    rw [e2, h1,
      step_of_tapeAction_write (nf_leaf N (some t)) e₁ (q := .blk₂ σ claim n mv last
        (e.workTapes 1 b)) 1 0 (some v) m rfl htr]
  have htape2 : Function.update e₁.workTapes 1
      (Function.update (e₁.workTapes 1) (e₁.workTapePos 1) (some (n.getD false))) =
        Function.update e.workTapes 1 (nf_blockWrite (e.workTapes 1) b n) := by
    show Function.update (Function.update e.workTapes 1
      (Function.update (e.workTapes 1) (e.workTapePos 1) (some n.isSome))) 1
      (Function.update (Function.update e.workTapes 1
        (Function.update (e.workTapes 1) (e.workTapePos 1) (some n.isSome)) 1)
        (Function.update e.workTapePos 1 (e.workTapePos 1 + 1) 1) (some (n.getD false))) = _
    rw [Function.update_self, Function.update_self, Function.update_idem]
    rfl
  refine ⟨hpre, fun hdec hl => ?_, fun hdec hl => ?_, fun hdec => ?_⟩
  · subst hl
    rw [hw2 .pass 0 (n.getD false) (by
      simp only [nf_leaf]
      rw [hsym1, if_pos hdec]
      rfl), htape2]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · rfl
    · exact moveInputPos_zero _ |>.trans (moveInputPos_zero _)
    · rfl
    · funext i
      by_cases hi : i = 1
      · subst hi
        simp only [he₁, Function.update_self, SignType.coe_zero, add_zero]
        rfl
      · simp only [he₁, Function.update_of_ne hi]
    · rfl
  · subst hl
    -- the second block step, then the two head adjustments
    set m₂ : SignType := if mv = 1 then 1 else -1 with hm₂
    set m₃ : SignType := if mv = -1 then -1 else 0 with hm₃
    have h2 := hw2 (.adj₁ σ mv) m₂ (n.getD false) (by
      simp only [nf_leaf]
      rw [hsym1, if_pos hdec]
      rfl)
    rw [htape2] at h2
    set e₂ : Cfg 2 Bool (nf_LeafSt N) x := { e₁ with
        state := some (.adj₁ σ mv)
        inputPos := moveInputPos e₁.inputPos 0
        workTapes := Function.update e.workTapes 1 (nf_blockWrite (e.workTapes 1) b n)
        workTapePos := Function.update e₁.workTapePos 1 (e₁.workTapePos 1 + m₂) } with he₂
    have h3 : (nf_leaf N (some t)).runFrom e 3 = { e₂ with
        state := some (.adj₂ σ mv)
        inputPos := moveInputPos e₂.inputPos 0
        workTapePos := Function.update e₂.workTapePos 1 (e₂.workTapePos 1 + m₃) } := by
      rw [show (3 : ℕ) = 2 + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', h2,
        step_of_tapeAction_move (nf_leaf N (some t)) e₂ (q := .adj₁ σ mv) 1 0 m₃ rfl rfl]
    have h4 : (nf_leaf N (some t)).runFrom e 4 = { e₂ with
        state := some (.read σ)
        inputPos := moveInputPos (moveInputPos e₂.inputPos 0) 0
        workTapePos := Function.update (Function.update e₂.workTapePos 1 (e₂.workTapePos 1 + m₃)) 1
          (Function.update e₂.workTapePos 1 (e₂.workTapePos 1 + m₃) 1 + m₃) } := by
      rw [show (4 : ℕ) = 3 + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', h3,
        step_of_tapeAction_move (nf_leaf N (some t)) _ (q := .adj₂ σ mv) 1 0 m₃ rfl rfl]
    refine ⟨fun u hu s hs => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases (by omega : u < 2 ∨ u = 2 ∨ u = 3) with hu2 | rfl | rfl
      · exact hpre u hu2 s hs
      · rw [h2] at hs
        cases hs
        rfl
      · rw [h3] at hs
        cases hs
        rfl
    · rw [h4]
      apply Cfg.ext
      · rfl
      · show moveInputPos (moveInputPos (moveInputPos (moveInputPos e.inputPos 0) 0) 0) 0 = _
        rw [moveInputPos_zero, moveInputPos_zero, moveInputPos_zero, moveInputPos_zero]
      · rfl
      · funext i
        by_cases hi : i = 1
        · subst hi
          simp only [he₂, he₁, Function.update_self]
          rw [hm₂, hm₃]
          rcases mv with _ | _ | _ <;> simp <;> ring
        · simp only [he₂, he₁, Function.update_of_ne hi]
      · rfl
  · have e2 : (nf_leaf N (some t)).runFrom e 2 =
        (nf_leaf N (some t)).step ((nf_leaf N (some t)).runFrom e 1) :=
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step'
    rw [e2, h1, step_of_tapeAction_move (nf_leaf N (some t)) e₁ (q := .blk₂ σ claim n mv last
        (e.workTapes 1 b)) (q' := .rej) 1 0 0 rfl (by
        simp only [nf_leaf]
        rw [hsym1, if_neg hdec])]

/-- **The read of one record by a work-tape instance.** From a record boundary, with the record on
tape `0` from its head, the instance for work tape `t` reads the record in `2k + 4` steps, at no
exit before. At a live control it is then at the first cell of the block on tape `1`, carrying
the decoded claim on tape `t`, the cell's new content under the recomputed action, the simulated
move and the end flag, with the head of tape `0` one cell past the record and nothing else
changed; at a halted control it rejects.

**Proof sketch.** Up to the record's last bit the leaf reads the record, and there the parser
completes it. The leaf's table at a live control is then a right move on tape `0` into the block's
first state, with the record's decoded claims and recomputed action. -/

private lemma cont_copy_run (N : FinNDTM Bool) (y rest : List Bool) :
    ∀ (pre x u : List Bool) (hy : y = pre ++ rest),
    (contPairTM N).tm.runFrom
      (contLoadCfg (y := y) N 3 x u ⟨pre.length + 1, by simp [hy]; omega⟩
        x.length u.length) rest.length =
          contLoadCfg (y := y) N 3 x (u ++ rest) ⟨y.length + 1, by omega⟩
            x.length (u ++ rest).length := by
  induction rest with
  | nil => intro pre x u hy; subst y; simp [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
  | cons b rest ih =>
    intro pre x u hy
    have hs := cont_load_right (y := y) N 3 3 x u pre.length (by simp [hy]) none (some b) (by
      have hr : y[pre.length]? = some b := by simp [hy]
      rw [hr]
      rfl)
    simp only [Option.toList_none, Option.toList_some, List.append_nil] at hs
    simp only [List.length_cons, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step]
    rw [hs]
    have hh : y = (pre ++ [b]) ++ rest := by simp [hy, List.append_assoc]
    simpa only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton, List.append_assoc,
      List.singleton_append] using ih (pre ++ [b]) x (u ++ [b]) hh

/-- After suffix copying, one left move plus the two exact rewinds enters the
proved simulator. No source choices are consumed during these administrative steps. -/

private lemma satRed_maxOnes (x : List Bool) (v : ℕ) :
    ∀ pre rest (hx : x = pre ++ List.replicate v true ++ rest)
      (n j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ n) (buf : ℤ → Option Bool) (b : ℤ) (out : List Bool),
    satRedTM.tm.runFrom
      (satRedCfg x (some 4) pre.length (by simp [hx]) n buf j b out) v =
      satRedCfg x (some 4) (pre.length + v) (by simp [hx])
        (max n (j + v)) buf (j + v) b out := by
  induction v with
  | zero => intros; simp [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, max_eq_left, *]
  | succ v ih =>
    intro pre rest hx n j hj buf b out
    have hx' : x = (pre ++ [true]) ++ List.replicate v true ++ rest := by
      simpa [List.replicate_succ, List.append_assoc] using hx
    have hs : satRedTM.tm.step
        (satRedCfg x (some 4) pre.length (by simp [hx]) n buf j b out) =
        satRedCfg x (some 4) (pre.length + 1) (by simp [hx'])
          (max n (j + 1)) buf (j + 1) b out := by
      unfold MultiTapeTM.step
      change (satRedTM.tm.tr (4 : Fin 35) _ _).apply _ = _
      rw [satRedCfg_input, show x[pre.length]? = some true by simp [hx', List.append_assoc]]
      change (satRedAction .pos (some (some true)) none .pos 0 none (some 4)).apply _ = _
      exact satRedAction_apply x (some 4) (some 4) _ _ _ _ n (max n (j + 1))
        buf buf j b (j + 1) b out out .pos (some (some true)) none .pos 0 none
        (moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right _ (by simp [hx'] <;> omega))
        (satRedCounter_write n j hj) rfl (by simp) (by simp) (by simp)
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, hs]
    have h := ih (pre ++ [true]) rest hx' (max n (j + 1)) (j + 1) (Nat.le_max_right _ _)
      buf b out
    have he : max (max n (j + 1)) (j + 1 + v) = max n (j + (v + 1)) := by omega
    simpa [he, Nat.add_assoc, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using h

/-- One literal in the maximum pass takes `2v+5` transitions, records the
maximum of the prior bound and `v+1`, and restores the counter head.

**Proof sketch.** Consume the first unary bit, scan the remaining index bits, and consume the zero
separator. Rewind the counter before skipping polarity. The five phases cost one, v,
one, v+2, and one steps. -/

private lemma satDrop_skip (x : List Bool) (p n : ℕ) :
    ∀ r, r ≤ n → satDropTM.tm.runFrom (satDropCfg x (some 4) p n 0 []) r =
      satDropCfg x (some 4) (p + r) n r [] := by
  intro r
  induction r with
  | zero => intro _; simp [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
  | succ r ih =>
    intro hr
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega)]
    have hw : (satDropCfg x (some 4) (p + r) n r []).workTapeSymbols 0 = some true := by
      simp [satDropCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols, satRedCounter_read, show r < n by omega]
    unfold MultiTapeTM.step
    change (satDropTM.tm.tr (4 : Fin 6) _ _).apply _ = _
    simp only [satDropTM, hw, Option.isSome_some, ↓reduceIte]
    simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using satDrop_move x (some 4) (some 4) (p + r) (p + r + 1)
      n (r : ℤ) ((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) .pos .pos none [] (satStreamPos_succ _ _) (by simp)

/-- Counter exhaustion dispatches to the native copy phase without moving
past the first unconsumed payload bit. -/

private lemma pal_copy (x : List Bool) : ∀ t (ht : t ≤ x.length),
    palTM.tm.runFrom (palTM.tm.initCfg x) t =
      palCfg x 0 ⟨t + 1, by omega⟩ t t := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    intro ht
    apply Cfg.ext
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · funext j z
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init, palCfg, palTape]
      rw [if_neg (by omega)]
    · rfl
    · rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    intro ht
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega)]
    exact pal_copy_step x t (by omega)

/-- The right blank starts the rewind with the input head at position `n`. -/

private theorem qy_cmp_run {K : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (a b : Fin K) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (T : Fin K → ℤ → Option Bool) (P : Fin K → ℤ) (o : List Bool)
    (u v : List Bool) (hTa : T a = FinTM.bufferTape u) (hTb : T b = FinTM.bufferTape v)
    (hPa : P a = 0) (hPb : P b = 0) :
    (qyCmpTM K a b).runFrom (qyC .scan ip T P o) (2 * min u.length v.length + 2) =
        qyC (QyCmp.done (compare u.length v.length)) ip T P o ∧
      ∀ t < 2 * min u.length v.length + 2, ∀ w,
        ((qyCmpTM K a b).runFrom (qyC .scan ip T P o) t).state ≠ some (.done w) := by
  set m := min u.length v.length with hm
  have hP0 : qyAt2 P a b 0 = P := by
    funext j
    unfold qyAt2
    by_cases hb : j = b
    · subst hb; rw [Function.update_self, hPb]
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hb]
      by_cases ha : j = a
      · subst ha; rw [Function.update_self, hPa]
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne ha]
  have hra : ∀ i : ℤ, T a (qyAt2 P a b i a) = FinTM.bufferTape u i := by
    intro i
    unfold qyAt2
    rw [Function.update_of_ne hab, Function.update_self, hTa]
  have hrb : ∀ i : ℤ, T b (qyAt2 P a b i b) = FinTM.bufferTape v i := by
    intro i
    unfold qyAt2
    rw [Function.update_self, hTb]
  -- the forward scan
  have hscan : ∀ i ≤ m, (qyCmpTM K a b).runFrom (qyC .scan ip T P o) i =
      qyC .scan ip T (qyAt2 P a b i) o := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero => intro _; rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, Nat.cast_zero, hP0]
    | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega)]
      have hu : FinTM.bufferTape u (i : ℤ) = some u[i] := by
        rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)]
      have hv : FinTM.bufferTape v (i : ℤ) = some v[i] := by
        rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)]
      have h := qy_step (qyCmpTM K a b) QyCmp.scan QyCmp.scan ip T (qyAt2 P a b i) o
        (fun j => if j = a ∨ j = b then .pos else 0) none (by
          simp only [qyCmpTM]
          rw [hra, hrb, hu, hv])
      rw [h, qyAt2_move P a b i .pos 1 (by rfl), Option.toList_none, List.append_nil]
      push_cast
      rfl
  -- the turn
  have hturn : (qyCmpTM K a b).runFrom (qyC .scan ip T P o) (m + 1) =
      qyC (QyCmp.back (compare u.length v.length)) ip T (qyAt2 P a b ((m : ℤ) - 1)) o := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', hscan m le_rfl]
    have hmv : (fun j => qyAt2 P a b m j + ((if j = a ∨ j = b then SignType.neg else 0 :
        SignType) : ℤ)) = qyAt2 P a b ((m : ℤ) - 1) := by
      rw [qyAt2_move P a b m .neg (-1) (by rfl), sub_eq_add_neg]
    rcases lt_trichotomy u.length v.length with hlt | heq | hgt
    · have hmu : m = u.length := by omega
      have hu : FinTM.bufferTape u (m : ℤ) = none := by
        rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]
      have hv : FinTM.bufferTape v (m : ℤ) = some v[m] := by
        rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)]
      rw [qy_step (qyCmpTM K a b) QyCmp.scan (QyCmp.back .lt) ip T (qyAt2 P a b m) o
        (fun j => if j = a ∨ j = b then .neg else 0) none (by
          simp only [qyCmpTM]
          rw [hra, hrb, hu, hv]), hmv, Option.toList_none, List.append_nil,
        (compare_lt_iff_lt.mpr hlt)]
    · have hu : FinTM.bufferTape u (m : ℤ) = none := by
        rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]
      have hv : FinTM.bufferTape v (m : ℤ) = none := by
        rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]
      rw [qy_step (qyCmpTM K a b) QyCmp.scan (QyCmp.back .eq) ip T (qyAt2 P a b m) o
        (fun j => if j = a ∨ j = b then .neg else 0) none (by
          simp only [qyCmpTM]
          rw [hra, hrb, hu, hv]), hmv, Option.toList_none, List.append_nil,
        (compare_eq_iff_eq.mpr heq)]
    · have hu : FinTM.bufferTape u (m : ℤ) = some u[m] := by
        rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)]
      have hv : FinTM.bufferTape v (m : ℤ) = none := by
        rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]
      rw [qy_step (qyCmpTM K a b) QyCmp.scan (QyCmp.back .gt) ip T (qyAt2 P a b m) o
        (fun j => if j = a ∨ j = b then .neg else 0) none (by
          simp only [qyCmpTM]
          rw [hra, hrb, hu, hv]), hmv, Option.toList_none, List.append_nil,
        (compare_gt_iff_gt.mpr hgt)]
  -- the return pass
  have hback : ∀ i ≤ m, (qyCmpTM K a b).runFrom (qyC .scan ip T P o) (m + 1 + i) =
      qyC (QyCmp.back (compare u.length v.length)) ip T
        (qyAt2 P a b ((m : ℤ) - 1 - i)) o := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero => intro _; rw [Nat.add_zero, hturn, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero]
    | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega)]
      have hu : FinTM.bufferTape u ((m : ℤ) - 1 - i) = some u[m - 1 - i] := by
        rw [show ((m : ℤ) - 1 - i) = ((m - 1 - i : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega, FinTM.bufferTape_nat,
          List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)]
      rw [qy_step (qyCmpTM K a b) _ _ ip T _ o (fun j => if j = a ∨ j = b then .neg else 0) none
        (by
          simp only [qyCmpTM]
          rw [hra, hu]), qyAt2_move P a b _ .neg (-1) (by rfl), Option.toList_none,
        List.append_nil]
      congr 2
      push_cast
      ring
  have hend : (qyCmpTM K a b).runFrom (qyC .scan ip T P o) (2 * m + 2) =
      qyC (QyCmp.done (compare u.length v.length)) ip T P o := by
    rw [show 2 * m + 2 = m + 1 + m + 1 by ring, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step',
      hback m le_rfl]
    have hu : FinTM.bufferTape u ((m : ℤ) - 1 - m) = none := by
      rw [show ((m : ℤ) - 1 - m) = -1 by ring, FinTM.bufferTape_left]
    rw [qy_step (qyCmpTM K a b) _ _ ip T _ o (fun j => if j = a ∨ j = b then .pos else 0) none
      (by
        simp only [qyCmpTM]
        rw [hra, hu]), qyAt2_move P a b _ .pos 1 (by rfl), Option.toList_none, List.append_nil,
      show ((m : ℤ) - 1 - m + 1) = 0 by ring, hP0]
  refine ⟨hend, fun t ht w => ?_⟩
  by_cases h1 : t ≤ m
  · rw [hscan t h1]
    intro h
    cases Option.some.inj h
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, t = m + 1 + i := ⟨t - (m + 1), by omega⟩
    rw [hback i (by omega)]
    intro h
    cases Option.some.inj h

/-- The control states of the writer's emitter `Turing.NTimeDiag.qyEmitTM`: emitting the fixed
prefix, reading a cell, holding a read symbol while looking ahead, emitting its copies, emitting
the fixed suffix, and the exit, whose action halts. -/

private theorem qy_emit_run {K : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (i : Fin K) (pre suf : List Bool) (rr : ℕ)
    (dl : Bool) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (T : Fin K → ℤ → Option Bool) (P : Fin K → ℤ)
    (o : List Bool) (w : List Bool) (hT : T i = FinTM.bufferTape w) (hP : P i = 0) :
    ∃ t ≤ pre.length + suf.length + 3 + w.length * (rr + 3),
      (qyEmitTM K i pre suf rr dl).runFrom (qyC (.pre 0) ip T P o) t =
        qyC .done ip T (Function.update P i w.length) (o ++ pre ++ qyBody dl rr w ++ suf) ∧
      ∀ u < t, ((qyEmitTM K i pre suf rr dl).runFrom (qyC (.pre 0) ip T P o) u).state ≠
        some .done := by
  set M := qyEmitTM K i pre suf rr dl with hM
  -- the prefix
  have hpre : ∀ (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ pre.length), M.runFrom (qyC (.pre 0) ip T P o) j =
      qyC (.pre ⟨j, by omega⟩) ip T P (o ++ pre.take j) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro _; rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, List.take_zero, List.append_nil]; rfl
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega),
        qy_step M _ (.pre ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩) ip T P _ (fun _ => 0) (some pre[j]) (by
          simp only [hM, qyEmitTM]
          rw [dif_pos (show j < pre.length by omega)]), qy_noMove, List.append_assoc,
        Option.toList_some, List.take_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)]
      rfl
  have hpre' : M.runFrom (qyC (.pre 0) ip T P o) (pre.length + 1) =
      qyC .rd ip T P (o ++ pre) := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', hpre _ le_rfl,
      qy_step M _ .rd ip T P _ (fun _ => 0) none (by
        simp only [hM, qyEmitTM]
        rw [dif_neg (show ¬ (pre.length < pre.length) by omega)]), qy_noMove,
      List.take_length, Option.toList_none, List.append_nil]
  -- the copies of one symbol
  have hem : ∀ (b : Bool) (Q : Fin K → ℤ) (o' : List Bool) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ rr),
      M.runFrom (qyC (.em b 0) ip T Q o') k =
        qyC (.em b ⟨k, by omega⟩) ip T Q (o' ++ List.replicate k b) := by
    intro b Q o' k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro _; rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, List.replicate_zero, List.append_nil]; rfl
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega),
        qy_step M _ (.em b ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩) ip T Q _ (fun _ => 0) (some b) (by
          simp only [hM, qyEmitTM]
          rw [dif_pos (show k < rr by omega)]), qy_noMove, List.append_assoc,
        Option.toList_some, List.replicate_succ']
  have hem' : ∀ (b : Bool) (Q : Fin K → ℤ) (o' : List Bool),
      M.runFrom (qyC (.em b 0) ip T Q o') (rr + 1) =
        qyC .rd ip T Q (o' ++ List.replicate (rr + 1) b) := by
    intro b Q o'
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', hem b Q o' rr le_rfl,
      qy_step M _ .rd ip T Q _ (fun _ => 0) (some b) (by
        simp only [hM, qyEmitTM]
        rw [dif_neg (show ¬ (rr < rr) by omega)]), qy_noMove, List.append_assoc,
      Option.toList_some, List.replicate_succ' (n := rr)]
  -- the body: from the cell `k`, with the rest of the word `rest`
  have hbody : ∀ (rest : List Bool) (k : ℕ) (o' : List Bool), k ≤ w.length → w.drop k = rest →
      ∃ t ≤ rest.length * (rr + 3) + 1,
        M.runFrom (qyC .rd ip T (Function.update P i k) o') t =
          qyC (.suf 0) ip T (Function.update P i w.length) (o' ++
            (if dl then rest.dropLast else rest).flatMap fun b => List.replicate (rr + 1) b) ∧
        ∀ u < t, (M.runFrom (qyC .rd ip T (Function.update P i k) o') u).state ≠ some .done := by
    intro rest
    induction rest with
    | nil =>
      intro k o' hkw' hk
      have hkw : k = w.length := by
        have := congrArg List.length hk
        rw [List.length_drop, List.length_nil] at this
        omega
      subst hkw
      refine ⟨1, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one, qy_step M _ (.suf 0) ip T _ _ (fun _ => 0) none (by
            have hn : T i (Function.update P i (w.length : ℤ) i) = none := by
              rw [Function.update_self, hT, FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_none le_rfl]
            simp only [hM, qyEmitTM, hn]),
          qy_noMove, Option.toList_none, List.append_nil]
        cases dl <;> simp
      · intro u hu
        obtain rfl : u = 0 := by omega
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
        intro h
        cases Option.some.inj h
    | cons b rest ih =>
      intro k o' hkw' hk
      have hkb : FinTM.bufferTape w (k : ℤ) = some b := by
        rw [FinTM.bufferTape_nat, ← List.head?_drop, hk]
        rfl
      have hk1 : FinTM.bufferTape w ((k : ℤ) + 1) = rest.head? := by
        rw [show (k : ℤ) + 1 = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, FinTM.bufferTape_nat,
          ← List.head?_drop, ← List.drop_drop, hk]
        rfl
      have hstep1 : M.runFrom (qyC .rd ip T (Function.update P i k) o') 1 =
          qyC (.got b) ip T (Function.update P i ((k : ℤ) + 1)) o' := by
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one, qy_step M _ (.got b) ip T _ _
            (fun j => if j = i then .pos else 0) none (by
            have hn : T i (Function.update P i (k : ℤ) i) = some b := by
              rw [Function.update_self, hT, hkb]
            simp only [hM, qyEmitTM, hn]), qy_moveOne, Function.update_self,
          Function.update_idem, Option.toList_none, List.append_nil]
      by_cases hlast : rest = [] ∧ dl = true
      · obtain ⟨rfl, hdl⟩ := hlast
        refine ⟨2, by simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil]; omega, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [qy_run_two, hstep1,
            qy_step M _ (.suf 0) ip T _ _ (fun _ => 0) none (by
              have hn : T i (Function.update P i ((k : ℤ) + 1) i) = none := by
                rw [Function.update_self, hT, hk1]
                rfl
              simp only [hM, qyEmitTM, hn, hdl]
              rfl), qy_noMove, Option.toList_none, List.append_nil, hdl]
          have hkw : k + 1 = w.length := by
            have := congrArg List.length hk
            rw [List.length_drop, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at this
            omega
          rw [show ((k : ℤ) + 1) = ((w.length : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega]
          simp
        · intro u hu
          rcases (show u = 0 ∨ u = 1 by omega) with rfl | rfl
          · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
            intro h
            cases Option.some.inj h
          · rw [hstep1]
            intro h
            cases Option.some.inj h
      · have hstep2 : M.runFrom (qyC .rd ip T (Function.update P i k) o') 2 =
            qyC (.em b 0) ip T (Function.update P i ((k : ℤ) + 1)) o' := by
          rw [qy_run_two, hstep1,
            qy_step M _ (.em b 0) ip T _ _ (fun _ => 0) none (by
              have hn : T i (Function.update P i ((k : ℤ) + 1) i) = rest.head? := by
                rw [Function.update_self, hT, hk1]
              have hc : ¬(rest.head? = none ∧ dl = true) := by
                rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
                exact hlast ⟨List.head?_eq_none_iff.mp h1, h2⟩
              simp only [hM, qyEmitTM, hn, if_neg hc]), qy_noMove,
            Option.toList_none, List.append_nil]
        have hrd : M.runFrom (qyC .rd ip T (Function.update P i k) o') (2 + (rr + 1)) =
            qyC .rd ip T (Function.update P i ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
              (o' ++ List.replicate (rr + 1) b) := by
          rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hstep2, hem']
          push_cast
          rfl
        have hkl : k + 1 ≤ w.length := by
          have := congrArg List.length hk
          rw [List.length_drop, List.length_cons] at this
          omega
        obtain ⟨t, ht, hrun, hcut⟩ := ih (k + 1) (o' ++ List.replicate (rr + 1) b) hkl
          (by rw [← List.drop_drop, hk]; rfl)
        refine ⟨2 + (rr + 1) + t, by rw [List.length_cons]; nlinarith, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrd, hrun, List.append_assoc]
          congr 2
          have hd : (if dl then (b :: rest).dropLast else b :: rest) =
              b :: (if dl then rest.dropLast else rest) := by
            cases dl
            · rfl
            · have hr : rest ≠ [] := fun h => hlast ⟨h, rfl⟩
              simp only [if_true]
              exact List.dropLast_cons_of_ne_nil hr
          rw [hd, List.flatMap_cons]
        · intro u hu
          by_cases h2 : u < 2
          · rcases (show u = 0 ∨ u = 1 by omega) with rfl | rfl
            · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
              intro h
              cases Option.some.inj h
            · rw [hstep1]
              intro h
              cases Option.some.inj h
          · by_cases h3 : u < 2 + (rr + 1)
            · obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ : ∃ v, u = 2 + v := ⟨u - 2, by omega⟩
              rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hstep2]
              rcases (show v ≤ rr by omega).lt_or_eq with hv | rfl
              · rw [hem b _ _ v hv.le]
                intro h
                cases Option.some.inj h
              · rw [hem b _ _ v le_rfl]
                intro h
                cases Option.some.inj h
            · obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ : ∃ v, u = 2 + (rr + 1) + v := ⟨u - (2 + (rr + 1)), by omega⟩
              rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrd]
              exact hcut v (by omega)
  -- the suffix
  have hsuf : ∀ (Q : Fin K → ℤ) (o' : List Bool) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ suf.length),
      M.runFrom (qyC (.suf 0) ip T Q o') j =
        qyC (.suf ⟨j, by omega⟩) ip T Q (o' ++ suf.take j) := by
    intro Q o' j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro _; rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, List.take_zero, List.append_nil]; rfl
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega),
        qy_step M _ (.suf ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩) ip T Q _ (fun _ => 0) (some suf[j]) (by
          simp only [hM, qyEmitTM]
          rw [dif_pos (show j < suf.length by omega)]), qy_noMove, List.append_assoc,
        Option.toList_some, List.take_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)]
      rfl
  have hsuf' : ∀ (Q : Fin K → ℤ) (o' : List Bool),
      M.runFrom (qyC (.suf 0) ip T Q o') (suf.length + 1) = qyC .done ip T Q (o' ++ suf) := by
    intro Q o'
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', hsuf Q o' _ le_rfl,
      qy_step M _ .done ip T Q _ (fun _ => 0) none (by
        simp only [hM, qyEmitTM]
        rw [dif_neg (show ¬ (suf.length < suf.length) by omega)]), qy_noMove,
      List.take_length, Option.toList_none, List.append_nil]
  -- assembly
  obtain ⟨tb, htb, hbrun, hbcut⟩ := hbody w 0 (o ++ pre) (Nat.zero_le _) (List.drop_zero)
  have hP' : Function.update P i ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = P := by
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, ← hP, Function.update_eq_self]
  rw [hP'] at hbrun hbcut
  refine ⟨pre.length + 1 + tb + (suf.length + 1), by nlinarith, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add _ (pre.length + 1 + tb) (suf.length + 1),
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add _ (pre.length + 1) tb, hpre', hbrun, hsuf']
    rfl
  · intro u hu
    by_cases h1 : u ≤ pre.length
    · rw [hpre u h1]
      intro h
      cases Option.some.inj h
    · by_cases h2 : u < pre.length + 1 + tb
      · obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ : ∃ v, u = pre.length + 1 + v := ⟨u - (pre.length + 1), by omega⟩
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hpre']
        exact hbcut v (by omega)
      · obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ : ∃ v, u = pre.length + 1 + tb + v := ⟨u - (pre.length + 1 + tb), by omega⟩
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add _ (pre.length + 1 + tb) v,
          MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add _ (pre.length + 1) tb, hpre', hbrun, hsuf _ _ v (by omega)]
        intro h
        cases Option.some.inj h

/-- **A released call stops first at its exit time.** From the install call's contract alone (a
positive exit time, the positive cut, the endpoint), the call wrapped by `seamReleaseTM` at its
entry, started at the fresh state and stopped at `Sum.inr exit`, first stops exactly at the
call's exit time, at the right-tagged endpoint. No `entry ≠ exit` is needed.

**Proof sketch.** At every positive time the released run is the call's run, right-tagged
(`Turing.seamReleaseTM_runFrom_pos`). At the exit time it is therefore the right-tagged
endpoint, stopped. Earlier it is the fresh state at time `0`, and the call's live, right-tagged
state off `exit` at positive times (the positive cut; liveness from the endpoint, by
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_state_ne_none_of_le`), so not stopped. -/

private theorem un_bank_run {k : ℕ} {z : List Bool} (S : Finset (Fin k)) (g : Fin k)
    (hg : g ∉ S) (L : ℕ) (w : Fin k → List Bool)
    (hw : ∀ i, i ∈ S ∨ i = g → (w i).length = L)
    (d : Cfg k Bool (Fin 3) z) (hstate : d.state = some 0)
    (htape : ∀ i, i ∈ S ∨ i = g → d.workTapes i = FinTM.bufferTape (w i))
    (hpos : ∀ i, i ∈ S ∨ i = g → d.workTapePos i = (L : ℤ)) :
    (un_bankTM k S g).runFrom d (L + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some 2
          workTapes := fun i => if i ∈ S then (fun _ => none) else d.workTapes i
          workTapePos := fun i => if i ∈ S ∨ i = g then 0 else d.workTapePos i } ∧
      ∀ t < L + 2, ((un_bankTM k S g).runFrom d t).state ≠ some 2 := by
  classical
  -- the sweep's trajectory
  let T : ℕ → Cfg k Bool (Fin 3) z := fun r =>
    { d with
      state := some (if r = 0 then 0 else 1)
      workTapes := fun i =>
        if i ∈ S then (fun q => if (L : ℤ) - r < q then none else FinTM.bufferTape (w i) q)
        else d.workTapes i
      workTapePos := fun i => if i ∈ S ∨ i = g then (L : ℤ) - r else d.workTapePos i }
  have hT0 : T 0 = d := by
    refine Cfg.ext ?_ rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
    · show some (if 0 = 0 then (0 : Fin 3) else 1) = d.state
      rw [if_pos rfl, hstate]
    · funext i q
      show (if i ∈ S then (fun q => if (L : ℤ) - (0 : ℕ) < q then none
          else FinTM.bufferTape (w i) q) else d.workTapes i) q = d.workTapes i q
      by_cases hiS : i ∈ S
      · rw [if_pos hiS, htape i (Or.inl hiS)]
        by_cases hq : (L : ℤ) - (0 : ℕ) < q
        · rw [if_pos hq, eq_comm]
          exact un_buffer_ge _ _ (by rw [hw i (Or.inl hiS)]; push_cast at hq ⊢; omega)
        · rw [if_neg hq]
      · rw [if_neg hiS]
    · funext i
      show (if i ∈ S ∨ i = g then (L : ℤ) - (0 : ℕ) else d.workTapePos i) = d.workTapePos i
      by_cases hig : i ∈ S ∨ i = g
      · rw [if_pos hig, hpos i hig]
        omega
      · rw [if_neg hig]
  -- one erasing step of the sweep
  have happly : ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ L →
      (un_bankAct k S g .neg 1).apply (T r) = T (r + 1) := by
    intro r hr
    refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rw [Action.apply_state]
      show some 1 = some (if r + 1 = 0 then (0 : Fin 3) else 1)
      rw [if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero r)]
    · rw [Action.apply_inputPos]
      show moveInputPos (T r).inputPos (un_bankAct k S g .neg 1).inputTape = (T (r + 1)).inputPos
      rw [show (un_bankAct k S g .neg 1).inputTape = 0 from rfl, moveInputPos_zero]
    · funext i
      rw [Action.apply_workTapes, (un_bankAct_eq S g .neg 1 i).1]
      by_cases hiS : i ∈ S
      · rw [if_pos hiS, Option.getD_some]
        funext q
        rw [Function.update_apply]
        have hps : (T r).workTapePos i = (L : ℤ) - r := by
          show (if i ∈ S ∨ i = g then (L : ℤ) - r else d.workTapePos i) = _
          rw [if_pos (Or.inl hiS)]
        have htp : (T r).workTapes i =
            fun q => if (L : ℤ) - r < q then none else FinTM.bufferTape (w i) q := by
          show (if i ∈ S then _ else d.workTapes i) = _
          rw [if_pos hiS]
        have htp' : (T (r + 1)).workTapes i =
            fun q => if (L : ℤ) - (r + 1 : ℕ) < q then none else FinTM.bufferTape (w i) q := by
          show (if i ∈ S then _ else d.workTapes i) = _
          rw [if_pos hiS]
        rw [hps, htp, htp']
        dsimp only
        by_cases hq : q = (L : ℤ) - r
        · rw [if_pos hq, eq_comm,
            if_pos (show (L : ℤ) - (r + 1 : ℕ) < q by push_cast; omega)]
        · rw [if_neg hq]
          by_cases hql : (L : ℤ) - r < q
          · rw [if_pos hql,
              if_pos (show (L : ℤ) - (r + 1 : ℕ) < q by push_cast at hql ⊢; omega)]
          · rw [if_neg hql, if_neg (show ¬((L : ℤ) - (r + 1 : ℕ) < q) by
              push_cast at hq hql ⊢; omega)]
      · rw [if_neg hiS, Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq, Option.getD_none, Function.update_eq_self]
        show (T r).workTapes i = (T (r + 1)).workTapes i
        show (if i ∈ S then _ else d.workTapes i) = (if i ∈ S then _ else d.workTapes i)
        rw [if_neg hiS, if_neg hiS]
    · funext i
      rw [Action.apply_workTapePos]
      have hmv := (un_bankAct_eq S g .neg 1 i).2
      show (T r).workTapePos i + (((un_bankAct k S g .neg 1).workTapes i).2 : ℤ) =
        (T (r + 1)).workTapePos i
      rw [hmv]
      show (if i ∈ S ∨ i = g then (L : ℤ) - r else d.workTapePos i) + _ =
        (if i ∈ S ∨ i = g then (L : ℤ) - (r + 1 : ℕ) else d.workTapePos i)
      by_cases hig : i ∈ S ∨ i = g
      · rw [if_pos hig, if_pos hig, if_pos hig]
        rw [SignType.neg_eq_neg_one, SignType.coe_neg_one]
        omega
      · rw [if_neg hig, if_neg hig, if_neg hig, add_zero]
    · rw [Action.apply_output]
      show (T r).output ++ (none : Option Bool).toList = (T (r + 1)).output
      rw [Option.toList_none, List.append_nil]
  have hstep : ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ L → (un_bankTM k S g).step (T r) = T (r + 1) := by
    intro r hr
    have hs : (T r).state = some (if r = 0 then 0 else 1) := rfl
    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hs]
    have htr : (un_bankTM k S g).tr (if r = 0 then 0 else 1) (T r).inputSymbol
        (T r).workTapeSymbols = un_bankAct k S g .neg 1 := by
      by_cases hr0 : r = 0
      · rw [if_pos hr0]
        simp only [un_bankTM, ↓reduceIte]
      · rw [if_neg hr0]
        have hread : (T r).workTapeSymbols g =
            FinTM.bufferTape (w g) ((L : ℤ) - r) := by
          rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
          have h1 : (T r).workTapes g = FinTM.bufferTape (w g) := by
            show (if g ∈ S then _ else d.workTapes g) = _
            rw [if_neg hg, htape g (Or.inr rfl)]
          have h2 : (T r).workTapePos g = (L : ℤ) - r := by
            show (if g ∈ S ∨ g = g then (L : ℤ) - r else d.workTapePos g) = _
            rw [if_pos (Or.inr rfl)]
          rw [h1, h2]
        have hsome : ∃ b, FinTM.bufferTape (w g) ((L : ℤ) - r) = some b := by
          have hlt : L - r < (w g).length := by rw [hw g (Or.inr rfl)]; omega
          refine ⟨(w g)[L - r], ?_⟩
          rw [show (L : ℤ) - r = ((L - r : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega,
            FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt]
        obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hsome
        simp only [un_bankTM, Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [hread, hb]
    rw [htr]
    exact happly r hr
  have hrun : ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ L + 1 → (un_bankTM k S g).runFrom d r = T r := by
    intro r hr
    induction r with
    | zero => rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hT0]
    | succ r ih =>
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega), hstep r (by omega)]
  -- the final turning step
  have hfinal : (un_bankTM k S g).step (T (L + 1)) =
      { d with
        state := some 2
        workTapes := fun i => if i ∈ S then (fun _ => none) else d.workTapes i
        workTapePos := fun i => if i ∈ S ∨ i = g then 0 else d.workTapePos i } := by
    have hs : (T (L + 1)).state = some 1 := by
      show some (if L + 1 = 0 then (0 : Fin 3) else 1) = some 1
      rw [if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero L)]
    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hs]
    have hread : (T (L + 1)).workTapeSymbols g = none := by
      rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
      have h1 : (T (L + 1)).workTapes g = FinTM.bufferTape (w g) := by
        show (if g ∈ S then _ else d.workTapes g) = _
        rw [if_neg hg, htape g (Or.inr rfl)]
      have h2 : (T (L + 1)).workTapePos g = (L : ℤ) - (L + 1 : ℕ) := by
        show (if g ∈ S ∨ g = g then (L : ℤ) - (L + 1 : ℕ) else d.workTapePos g) = _
        rw [if_pos (Or.inr rfl)]
      rw [h1, h2]
      exact FinTM.bufferTape_of_neg _ (by push_cast; omega)
    have htr : (un_bankTM k S g).tr 1 (T (L + 1)).inputSymbol (T (L + 1)).workTapeSymbols =
        un_bankAct k S g .pos 2 := by
      simp only [un_bankTM, Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [hread]
    rw [htr]
    refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rw [Action.apply_state]
      rfl
    · rw [Action.apply_inputPos]
      rw [show (un_bankAct k S g .pos 2).inputTape = 0 from rfl, moveInputPos_zero]
    · funext i
      rw [Action.apply_workTapes, (un_bankAct_eq S g .pos 2 i).1]
      by_cases hiS : i ∈ S
      · rw [if_pos hiS, Option.getD_some]
        show Function.update ((T (L + 1)).workTapes i) ((T (L + 1)).workTapePos i) none =
          (if i ∈ S then (fun _ => none) else d.workTapes i)
        rw [if_pos hiS]
        have htp : (T (L + 1)).workTapes i =
            fun q => if (L : ℤ) - (L + 1 : ℕ) < q then none else FinTM.bufferTape (w i) q := by
          show (if i ∈ S then _ else d.workTapes i) = _
          rw [if_pos hiS]
        have hps : (T (L + 1)).workTapePos i = (L : ℤ) - (L + 1 : ℕ) := by
          show (if i ∈ S ∨ i = g then (L : ℤ) - (L + 1 : ℕ) else d.workTapePos i) = _
          rw [if_pos (Or.inl hiS)]
        rw [htp, hps]
        funext q
        rw [Function.update_apply]
        try dsimp only
        by_cases hq : q = (L : ℤ) - (L + 1 : ℕ)
        · rw [if_pos hq]
        · rw [if_neg hq]
          by_cases hql : (L : ℤ) - (L + 1 : ℕ) < q
          · rw [if_pos hql]
          · rw [if_neg hql]
            exact FinTM.bufferTape_of_neg _ (by push_cast at hql ⊢; omega)
      · rw [if_neg hiS, Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq, Option.getD_none, Function.update_eq_self]
        show (T (L + 1)).workTapes i = (if i ∈ S then _ else d.workTapes i)
        show (if i ∈ S then _ else d.workTapes i) = (if i ∈ S then _ else d.workTapes i)
        rw [if_neg hiS, if_neg hiS]
    · funext i
      rw [Action.apply_workTapePos]
      have hmv := (un_bankAct_eq S g .pos 2 i).2
      show (T (L + 1)).workTapePos i + (((un_bankAct k S g .pos 2).workTapes i).2 : ℤ) =
        (if i ∈ S ∨ i = g then 0 else d.workTapePos i)
      rw [hmv]
      show (if i ∈ S ∨ i = g then (L : ℤ) - (L + 1 : ℕ) else d.workTapePos i) + _ = _
      by_cases hig : i ∈ S ∨ i = g
      · rw [if_pos hig, if_pos hig, if_pos hig]
        rw [SignType.pos_eq_one, SignType.coe_one]
        omega
      · rw [if_neg hig, if_neg hig, if_neg hig, add_zero]
    · rw [Action.apply_output]
      show (T (L + 1)).output ++ (none : Option Bool).toList = d.output
      rw [Option.toList_none, List.append_nil]
  constructor
  · rw [show L + 2 = (L + 1) + 1 by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step',
      hrun (L + 1) le_rfl, hfinal]
  · intro t ht
    rw [hrun t (by omega)]
    show some (if t = 0 then (0 : Fin 3) else 1) ≠ some 2
    by_cases ht0 : t = 0
    · rw [if_pos ht0]; decide
    · rw [if_neg ht0]; decide

/-- One seam step whose previous endpoint arrives as a right-tagged configuration: the
handover's constant relabeling collapses the tag, so the next phase's framed run applies
verbatim. -/

theorem call_run (P : RProg m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
    (hl : c0.state = some l) (hcall : P.call l = some cs)
    (hW : ∀ r ∈ cs.args, c0.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape (W r))
    (hW0 : ∀ r ∈ cs.args, c0.workTapePos r = 0) (hnd : cs.args.Nodup)
    (hin : c0.inputPos.val = 1) (b : Bool) (B : ℕ)
    (hD : CleanRun D (q0 cs.dec) (vword (callSegs cs x W)) b B) :
    ∃ T, (∀ t ≤ T, RegBox cs c0.workTapePos W (fun r => ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom
          (seam c0) t).workTapePos (Fin.castAdd kD r)) ∧
        ∀ i, |((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (seam c0) t).workTapePos (Fin.natAdd m i)| ≤ B) ∧
      (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (seam c0) T =
        seam { c0 with state := some (if b then cs.yes else cs.no), inputPos := 1 } := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨T, hTh, hTo, hTt, hTp, hTb⟩ := hD
  set V := vword (callSegs cs x W) with hV
  set dc0 : Cfg kD Bool SD V := Cfg.init (q0 cs.dec) V with hdc0
  have hlen : cs.args.length ≤ m := by simpa using hnd.length_le_card
  -- the setup step
  have hsetup : (compileTM P l₀ D q0).step (seam c0) =
      mkCfg (some (.sim l (q0 cs.dec) 0 false true none)) c0.inputPos c0.workTapes
        (fun r => c0.workTapePos r + ((if r ∈ cs.args then -1 else 0 : SignType) : ℤ))
        (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) c0.output := by
    rw [seam_eq_mkCfg]
    unfold MultiTapeTM.step
    simp only [mkCfg_state, hl, Option.map_some]
    simp only [compileTM, ctr, hcall]
    rw [apply_moves, moveInputPos_zero]
  -- the first halting time of the decider
  have hex : ∃ t, (D.runFrom dc0 t).state = none := ⟨T, hTh⟩
  set T0 := Nat.find hex with hT0def
  have hT0 : (D.runFrom dc0 T0).state = none := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hT0le : T0 ≤ T := Nat.find_min' hex hTh
  have hlive : ∀ t < T0, (D.runFrom dc0 t).state ≠ none := fun t ht => Nat.find_min hex ht
  have hfin : D.runFrom dc0 T = D.runFrom dc0 T0 := by
    rw [show T = T0 + (T - T0) by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add,
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_of_halt _ hT0]
  have hT0pos : 0 < T0 := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos T0 with h | h
    · rw [h] at hT0; simp [dc0] at hT0
    · exact h
  -- the simulation relation at the start
  have hsim0 : SimRel c0 l cs W ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).step (seam c0)) dc0 := by
    have hw0 := wlen_zero_le cs x W
    let tp : TPos := if wlen (callSegs cs x W) 0 = 0 then .right else .cell 0 false
    refine ⟨q0 cs.dec, 0, false, true, tp, ?_, rfl, ?_⟩
    · rw [hsetup]; rfl
    refine ⟨by simp, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [tp]; split_ifs with h <;> simp [TPos.Valid]; omega
    · simp only [tp]; split_ifs <;> simp [Consistent]
    · simp only [tp, dc0, Cfg.init]
      split_ifs with h
      · simp only [vpos, wlen, rlen] at h ⊢; split <;> simp_all
      · simp [vpos, off_zero, cellOff]
    · rw [hsetup]
      simp only [mkCfg, tp, inPos, Fin.val_zero, ↓reduceIte, hin]
      split_ifs with h <;> simp [trackPos, h]
    · intro r; rw [hsetup]; simp [mkCfg]
    · intro r
      rw [hsetup]
      simp only [mkCfg, Fin.append_left, regPos]
      by_cases hr : r ∈ cs.args
      · simp [hr, hW0 r hr]
      · simp [hr]
    · intro i; rw [hsetup]; simp [mkCfg, dc0, Cfg.init]
    · intro i; rw [hsetup]; simp [mkCfg, dc0, Cfg.init]
    · rw [hsetup]; rfl
  -- the simulation, up to the halt
  have hsim : ∀ t ≤ T0, (t < T0 → SimRel c0 l cs W ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).step (seam c0)) t)
        (D.runFrom dc0 t)) ∧
      (t = T0 → HaltRel c0 l cs W ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).step (seam c0)) t) (D.runFrom dc0 t)) := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero => intro _; exact ⟨fun _ => hsim0, fun h => absurd h (by omega)⟩
    | succ t ih =>
      intro ht
      have h := (ih (by omega)).1 (by omega)
      have hs := sim_step l P D q0 hcall hW hnd h (l₀ := l₀)
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
      constructor
      · intro hlt
        apply hs.1
        rw [← MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
        exact hlive _ hlt
      · intro heq
        apply hs.2
        rw [← MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', heq]
        exact hT0
  -- the halt
  obtain ⟨s, par, dir, tp, hgst, -, R⟩ := (hsim T0 le_rfl).2 rfl
  have hout0 : (D.runFrom dc0 T0).output = [b] := by rw [← hfin]; exact hTo
  have hb : ((D.runFrom dc0 T0).output.head?.getD false) = b := by rw [hout0]; rfl
  set gH := (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).step (seam c0)) T0 with hgH
  have hgHeq : gH = mkCfg (some (.ret1 l s dir b)) gH.inputPos c0.workTapes
      (regPos c0 cs W s tp) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) c0.output := by
    refine Cfg.ext (by rw [hgst, hb]; rfl) rfl ?_ ?_ R.out
    · funext i z
      refine Fin.addCases (fun r => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
      · simp [mkCfg, R.regTape]
      · simp only [mkCfg, Fin.append_right, R.dTape]
        rw [← hfin, hTt]
    · funext i
      refine Fin.addCases (fun r => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
      · simp [mkCfg, R.regPos]
      · simp only [mkCfg, Fin.append_right, R.dPos]
        rw [← hfin, hTp]
  -- the return: input rewind
  have hret1 : (compileTM P l₀ D q0).step gH =
      mkCfg (some (.ret2 l s dir b)) (moveInputPos gH.inputPos (-1)) c0.workTapes
        (regPos c0 cs W s tp) (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) c0.output := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hgHeq]
    unfold MultiTapeTM.step
    simp only [mkCfg_state]
    simp only [compileTM, ctr]
    rw [apply_inputOnly]
  have hj : (moveInputPos gH.inputPos (-1)).val ≤ x.length := by
    rw [show (-1 : SignType) = .neg from rfl, FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]
    have := gH.inputPos.isLt; omega
  obtain ⟨hb2, hr2⟩ := ret2_run P l₀ D q0 l cs hcall s dir b c0.workTapes (regPos c0 cs W s tp)
    (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) c0.output _ _ rfl hj
  -- the return: argument registers
  have hbox0 := regPos_box (c0 := c0) hnd s tp R.valid R.hs
  have hret0 : retPos cs (regPos c0 cs W s tp) 0 = regPos c0 cs W s tp := by
    funext r; simp [retPos]
  obtain ⟨T₃, hb3, hr3⟩ := regs_run P l₀ D q0 l cs hcall hnd s dir b W c0.workTapes hW
    (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) c0.output 1 c0.workTapePos (regPos c0 cs W s tp) hbox0
    (fun a ha hm => regPos_side hnd s par dir tp R.cons R.valid a ha hm)
    cs.args.length 0 (by omega)
  rw [hret0] at hb3 hr3
  have hretL : retPos cs (regPos c0 cs W s tp) cs.args.length = c0.workTapePos := by
    funext r
    unfold retPos
    by_cases hr : r ∈ cs.args
    · simp [hr, List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem hr, hW0 r hr]
    · simp [hr, regPos]
  rw [hretL] at hr3
  -- assemble
  have hfinal : (mkCfg (some (CSt.prog (if b then cs.yes else cs.no))) 1 c0.workTapes
      c0.workTapePos (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) c0.output : Cfg (m + kD) Bool (CSt Λ SD m) x) =
      seam (kD := kD) (SD := SD)
        { c0 with state := some (if b then cs.yes else cs.no), inputPos := 1 } := by
    rw [seam_eq_mkCfg]; rfl
  refine ⟨1 + (T0 + (1 + ((moveInputPos gH.inputPos (-1)).val + 1 + T₃))), ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- the box along the whole call
    have hregBoxSeam : RegBox cs c0.workTapePos W c0.workTapePos := by
      intro r
      refine ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun hr => ?_⟩
      rw [hW0 r hr]; simp
    let Q : Cfg (m + kD) Bool (CSt Λ SD m) x → Prop := fun g =>
      RegBox cs c0.workTapePos W (fun r => g.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd kD r)) ∧
        ∀ i, |g.workTapePos (Fin.natAdd m i)| ≤ B
    show ∀ t ≤ _, Q ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (seam c0) t)
    apply runFrom_forall_append (Q := Q)
    · intro t ht
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t with h | h
      · subst h
        refine ⟨by simpa [seam] using hregBoxSeam, fun i => by simp [seam]⟩
      · obtain rfl : t = 1 := by omega
        rw [show (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (seam c0) 1 = ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).step (seam c0)) from MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one _ _]
        obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, R0⟩ := hsim0
        refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_⟩
        · intro r; simp only [R0.regPos]; exact regPos_box hnd _ _ R0.valid R0.hs r
        · rw [R0.dPos]; simp [dc0, Cfg.init]
    rw [show (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom (seam c0) 1 = (compileTM P l₀ D q0).step (seam c0)
      from MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one _ _]
    apply runFrom_forall_append (Q := Q)
    · intro t ht
      have hTR : ∃ s par dir tp, TrackRel c0 cs W ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).step (seam c0)) t)
          (D.runFrom dc0 t) s par dir tp := by
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t T0 with h | h
        · obtain ⟨_, s', par', dir', tp', -, -, R'⟩ := (hsim t ht).1 h
          exact ⟨s', par', dir', tp', R'⟩
        · obtain ⟨s', par', dir', tp', -, -, R'⟩ := (hsim t ht).2 (by omega)
          exact ⟨s', par', dir', tp', R'⟩
      obtain ⟨s', par', dir', tp', R'⟩ := hTR
      refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_⟩
      · intro r; simp only [R'.regPos]; exact regPos_box hnd s' tp' R'.valid R'.hs r
      · rw [R'.dPos]; exact hTb t (by omega) i
    apply runFrom_forall_append (Q := Q)
    · intro t ht
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t with h | h
      · subst h
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, ← hgH, hgHeq]
        exact ⟨fun r => by simpa [mkCfg] using hbox0 r, fun i => by simp [mkCfg]⟩
      · obtain rfl : t = 1 := by omega
        rw [show (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).step (seam c0)) T0) 1 =
          (compileTM P l₀ D q0).step gH from MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one _ _, hret1]
        exact ⟨fun r => by simpa [mkCfg] using hbox0 r, fun i => by simp [mkCfg]⟩
    rw [show (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).step (seam c0)) T0) 1 =
      (compileTM P l₀ D q0).step gH from MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one _ _, hret1]
    apply runFrom_forall_append (Q := Q)
    · intro t ht
      dsimp only [Q]
      rw [hb2 t ht]
      exact ⟨fun r => by simpa using hbox0 r, fun i => by simp⟩
    rw [hr2]
    intro t ht
    dsimp only [Q]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hb3 t ht
    refine ⟨h1, fun i => ?_⟩
    have := congrFun h2 i
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at this
    rw [this]; simp
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add]
    change (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom ((compileTM P l₀ D q0).step (seam c0)) _ = _
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, ← hgH, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add]
    rw [show (compileTM P l₀ D q0).runFrom gH 1 = (compileTM P l₀ D q0).step gH from MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one _ _, hret1,
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hr2, hr3, hfinal]


end Whole

private theorem recordStep_native_frame {K : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ}
    (R : MultiTapeTM K Γ S) (move : S → Option Γ → SignType)
    (next : S → Option Γ → S)
    (htr : ∀ q inp work, R.tr q inp work = inputMoveAction (move q inp) (next q inp))
    (d : Cfg K Γ S x) (t : ℕ) :
    (R.runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧
      (R.runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧ (R.runFrom d t).output = d.output := by
  induction t with
  | zero => rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
    cases hs : (R.runFrom d t).state with
    | none => rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_halt hs]; exact ih
    | some q =>
      rw [step_of_inputMoveAction R _ (move q _) hs (htr q _ _)]
      exact ih

/-- No public native-input-head primitive distinguishes the two blank boundaries.
This probe reads the current cell; at a blank it tries right and then moves left.
The Boolean verdict records the right boundary, whose resulting position is one cell left. -/

private theorem recordStep_probe_run {Γ : Type} {x : List Γ} (hx : 0 < x.length)
    (d : Cfg 4 Γ RecordStepProbe x) (hd : d.state = some .start) :
    ∃ t ≤ 2, ∃ b : Bool, ∃ p : Fin (x.length + 2),
      recordStepProbe.runFrom d t = {d with state := some (.done b), inputPos := p} ∧
      (∀ u < t, ∀ v, (recordStepProbe.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (.done v)) ∧
      b = decide (d.inputPos.val = x.length + 1) ∧
      p.val = (if b then x.length else d.inputPos.val) ∧
      (∀ u ≤ t, (recordStepProbe.runFrom d u).workTapePos = d.workTapePos) := by
  have fixed (t : ℕ) : (recordStepProbe.runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos := by
    exact (recordStep_native_frame recordStepProbe
      (fun q inp => match q with
        | .start => if inp.isSome then 0 else 1 | .peek => -1 | .done _ => 0)
      (fun q inp => match q with
        | .start => if inp.isSome then .done false else .peek
        | .peek => .done inp.isNone | .done b => .done b)
      (by intro q inp work; cases q <;> cases inp <;> rfl) d t).2.1
  have right (hR : d.inputPos.val = x.length + 1) : moveInputPos d.inputPos 1 = d.inputPos := by
    have he : d.inputPos = (⟨x.length + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) := Fin.ext hR
    rw [he]
    exact moveInputPos_rightBoundary
  by_cases hblank : d.inputSymbol = none
  · let a : Cfg 4 Γ RecordStepProbe x :=
      {d with state := some .peek, inputPos := moveInputPos d.inputPos 1}
    have step1 : recordStepProbe.step d = a :=
      step_of_inputMoveAction recordStepProbe d (q' := .peek) 1 hd (by
        simp [recordStepProbe, hblank])
    have step2 : recordStepProbe.step a =
        {d with state := some (.done a.inputSymbol.isNone), inputPos := moveInputPos a.inputPos (-1)} := by
      rw [step_of_inputMoveAction recordStepProbe a (q' := .done a.inputSymbol.isNone)
        (-1) rfl rfl]
    refine ⟨2, le_rfl, a.inputSymbol.isNone, moveInputPos a.inputPos (-1), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_,
      fun u _ => fixed u⟩
    · have h2 : recordStepProbe.runFrom d 2 =
          recordStepProbe.step (recordStepProbe.step d) := by
        have h := MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step' (tm := recordStepProbe) (cfg := d) (t := 1)
        rwa [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one] at h
      rw [h2, step1, step2]
    · intro u hu v
      have hu' : u = 0 ∨ u = 1 := by omega
      rcases hu' with rfl | rfl
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
        simp [hd]
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one, step1]
        simp [a]
    · rcases (recordStep_input_blank d).mp hblank with h0 | hR
      · have hpos : a.inputPos.val = 1 := by
          rw [show a.inputPos = moveInputPos d.inputPos 1 from rfl,
            show moveInputPos d.inputPos 1 =
                ⟨d.inputPos.val + 1, by have := d.inputPos.isLt; omega⟩ from
              moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right d.inputPos (by omega)]
          simp [h0]
        have hin := inputSymbolInner (cfg := a) 0 (by omega) hx
        simp [hin, h0]
      · have hpos : a.inputPos = d.inputPos := right hR
        have hin : a.inputSymbol = none := (recordStep_input_blank a).mpr (Or.inr (by
          rw [hpos]; exact hR))
        simp [hin, hR]
    · rcases (recordStep_input_blank d).mp hblank with h0 | hR
      · have hpos : a.inputPos.val = 1 := by
          rw [show a.inputPos = moveInputPos d.inputPos 1 from rfl,
            show moveInputPos d.inputPos 1 =
                ⟨d.inputPos.val + 1, by have := d.inputPos.isLt; omega⟩ from
              moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right d.inputPos (by omega)]
          simp [h0]
        have hin := inputSymbolInner (cfg := a) 0 (by omega) hx
        change (moveInputPos a.inputPos SignType.neg).val = _
        rw [FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]
        simp [hin, hpos, h0]
      · have hpos : a.inputPos.val = x.length + 1 := by change (moveInputPos d.inputPos 1).val = _; rw [right hR, hR]
        have hin : a.inputSymbol = none := (recordStep_input_blank a).mpr (Or.inr hpos)
        change (moveInputPos a.inputPos SignType.neg).val = _
        rw [FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val]
        simp [hin, hpos]
  · have hbound := (recordStep_input_blank d).not.mp hblank
    have hR : d.inputPos.val ≠ x.length + 1 := fun h => hbound (Or.inr h)
    have his : d.inputSymbol.isSome = true := by cases h : d.inputSymbol <;> simp_all
    refine ⟨1, by omega, false, d.inputPos, ?_, ?_, by simp [hR], rfl, fun u _ => fixed u⟩
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one]
      rw [step_of_inputMoveAction recordStepProbe d (q' := .done false) 0 hd
        (by simp [recordStepProbe, his]), moveInputPos_zero]
    · intro u hu v
      have : u = 0 := by omega

/-- Save's countdown reaches escape with the native head at zero, its work head restored,
and the complemented residual fuel coding q+1. The full counter-loop cut and trajectory
are retained for the later phase-host application.
**Proof sketch.** The save orbit exits in round q. All-one fuel is strictly larger than q;
apply `counterLoopTM_run_escape`, then its public arithmetic bounds and complement identity. -/

theorem embed_run (hmk : m ≤ k) (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool SS)
    (H : MultiTapeTM k Bool B) (inject : SS → B) (ex : SS)
    (htr : ∀ q : SS, q ≠ ex → ∀ inp work,
      H.tr (inject q) inp work =
        padAction hmk (Option.map inject)
          (M.tr q inp (fun i => work (Fin.castLE hmk i))))
    (c : Cfg m Bool SS x) (t : ℕ)
    (hstate : ∀ j < t, ∃ q, (M.runFrom c j).state = some q ∧ q ≠ ex) :
    H.runFrom (embedCfg hmk inject c) t = embedCfg hmk inject (M.runFrom c t) := by
  induction t generalizing c with
  | zero => simp
  | succ t ih =>
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqex⟩ := hstate 0 (by omega)
    simp only [runFrom_zero] at hq
    have hstep : H.step (embedCfg hmk inject c) = embedCfg hmk inject (M.step c) := by
      have hc : { embedCfg hmk inject c with state := some (inject q) } =
          embedCfg hmk inject c := by
        simp [embedCfg, hq]
      rw [← hc]
      exact embed_step hmk M H inject c q hq (inject q) (htr q hqex)
    rw [runFrom_succ_eq_step, runFrom_succ_eq_step, hstep]
    exact ih (M.step c) (fun j hj => by
      have := hstate (j + 1) (by omega)
      simpa [runFrom, Function.iterate_succ_apply] using this)


end Turing

    (hd : d.state = some (.inl ())) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hp : ℓ ≤ d.inputPos.val)
    (hr : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (ℓ : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + p) = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true) p)
    (u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ 2 * ℓ + 2) : rd_test.runFrom d u = rd_trace d ℓ u := by
