/-- **The restoring suffix-boundary test** (the ruler device's core). There is a one-tape binary
module with an entry and two distinct verdicts as follows. Start it at its entry with the
delimited ruler `true^ℓ`, `ℓ > 0`, at its head and the physical input head at a position `p ≥ ℓ`.
It reaches `yes` if `p = ℓ` and `no` otherwise, within `C · (ℓ + 1)` steps and no verdict
earlier, with nothing else changed: the input head is back at `p` and the ruler head at its
start, having stayed within `ℓ + 1` cells.
The input itself is arbitrary, so an empty payload is included. [AB09, §1.2]

**Proof sketch.** Move the input head left and the ruler head right in lockstep until the ruler
head reads the blank after the ruler: `ℓ` moves, none clamped since `p ≥ ℓ`. Read the input cell
at `p - ℓ`: it is blank exactly when `p - ℓ = 0`, since `p - ℓ ≤ |z| + 1 - ℓ ≤ |z|`
(`Turing.inputCell_sub_eq_none_iff`). Move both heads back `ℓ` cells (the ruler head stops at
the blank before the ruler, then steps right). A finite control carries the verdict.

**Implementation.** The test is a hand-built controller that moves the input head and the
ruler head in the same step (a `Turing.tapeAction`); no catalog row does that. One
forward-and-return trajectory, identified by a single induction, takes exactly `2ℓ + 2` steps, so
`C = 2`. The turn reads the boundary through `Turing.inputCell_sub_eq_none_iff`; the return leg
changes no tape and no output and restores both heads. -/

private theorem rd_host_block {m : ℕ} {S : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
    {y z : List Bool} (ℓ : ℕ) (hz : z.length = ℓ + y.length) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ)
    (hdrop : z.drop ℓ = y) (rt : ℤ → Option Bool) (rp : ℤ)
    (hr : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (ℓ : ℤ) →
      rt (rp + p) = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true) p) (c : Cfg m Bool S y) :
    (rd_hostTM M).runFrom (rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp c) (rd_hostCost M ℓ c) =
      rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp (M.step c) ∧
    (c.state ≠ none → ∀ u < rd_hostCost M ℓ c,
      ((rd_hostTM M).runFrom (rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp c) u).state ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ u ≤ rd_hostCost M ℓ c,
      rd_hostFrame ℓ rt rp c ((rd_hostTM M).runFrom (rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp c) u) ∨
      rd_hostFrame ℓ rt rp (M.step c)
        ((rd_hostTM M).runFrom (rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp c) u)) := by
  cases hq : c.state with
  | none =>
    have he : (rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp c).state = none := by
      simp only [rd_hostEnc, rulerHostCfg, hq, Option.map_none]
    have fixed (u : ℕ) := MultiTapeTM.runFrom_of_halt (tm := rd_hostTM M)
      (rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp c) he (n := u)
    refine ⟨?_, fun h => False.elim (h rfl), ?_⟩
    · rw [fixed, MultiTapeTM.step_of_halt hq]
    · intro u _
      rw [fixed]
      exact Or.inl (rd_hostFrame_layout ℓ hz _ c rt rp)
  | some q =>
    let b := decide (c.inputPos.val = 0)
    have hb : b = true ↔ c.inputPos.val = 0 := by simp only [b, decide_eq_true_eq]
    let a := M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols
    let d : Cfg (m + 1) Bool (rd_HostState S) z :=
      rulerHostCfg ℓ hz (rd_hostAction a b).state (M.step c) rt rp
    have hstate : (M.step c).state = a.state := by
      rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hq, Action.apply_state]
    have hinput : (M.step c).inputPos = moveInputPos c.inputPos a.inputTape := by
      rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hq, Action.apply_inputPos]
    have first : (rd_hostTM M).step (rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp c) = d := by
      simpa only [rd_hostEnc, hq, Option.map_some] using
        rd_host_source_step M ℓ hz hdrop c b hb rt rp q hq
    have rest :
        (rd_hostTM M).runFrom d (rd_hostCost M ℓ c - 1) = rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp (M.step c) ∧
        (∀ v < rd_hostCost M ℓ c - 1, ((rd_hostTM M).runFrom d v).state ≠ none) ∧
        (∀ v ≤ rd_hostCost M ℓ c - 1,
          rd_hostFrame ℓ rt rp (M.step c) ((rd_hostTM M).runFrom d v)) := by
      by_cases pause : a.state.isSome = true ∧ b = false ∧ a.inputTape = -1
      · have hcost : rd_hostCost M ℓ c - 1 = 2 * ℓ + 2 := by
          unfold rd_hostCost
          rw [hq, Option.elim_some, if_pos pause]
          omega
        rw [hcost]
        cases ha : a.state with
        | none =>
          simp only [ha, Option.isSome_none, Bool.false_eq_true] at pause
          exact False.elim pause.1
        | some q' =>
          have hd : d.state = some (rd_resume q' (.inl ())) := by
            simp only [d, rulerHostCfg, rd_hostAction, ha, Option.map_some,
              if_pos pause.2]
          have run := rd_pause_run M ℓ d q' hd hℓ (by
            change ℓ ≤ ℓ + (M.step c).inputPos.val; omega) (by
            intro p hp hp'
            simpa only [d, rulerHostCfg, Fin.lastCases_last] using hr p hp hp')
          refine ⟨?_, fun v hv => (run.2 v (by omega)).1, ?_⟩
          · rw [run.1]
            apply Cfg.ext
            · have tag : decide (d.inputPos.val = ℓ) =
                  decide ((M.step c).inputPos.val = 0) := by
                rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, decide_eq_true_eq, decide_eq_true_eq]
                change (ℓ + (M.step c).inputPos.val = ℓ) ↔ (M.step c).inputPos.val = 0
                omega
              change some (Sum.inl (q', decide (d.inputPos.val = ℓ)) : rd_HostState S) =
                (M.step c).state.map (fun r =>
                  (Sum.inl (r, decide ((M.step c).inputPos.val = 0)) : rd_HostState S))
              rw [hstate, ha, Option.map_some, tag]
            · rfl
            · rfl
            · rfl
            · rfl
          · intro v hv
            have frame := (run.2 v hv).2
            refine ⟨fun i => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
            · rw [frame.1]
              simp only [d, rulerHostCfg, Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
            · rw [frame.2.1 i]
              simp only [d, rulerHostCfg, Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
            · exact frame.2.2.1
            · rw [frame.1]
              simp only [d, rulerHostCfg, Fin.lastCases_last]
            · simpa only [d, rulerHostCfg, Fin.lastCases_last] using frame.2.2.2
      · have hcost : rd_hostCost M ℓ c - 1 = 0 := by
          unfold rd_hostCost
          rw [hq, Option.elim_some, if_neg pause]
        rw [hcost]
        have hd : d = rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp (M.step c) := by
          apply congrArg (fun s => rulerHostCfg ℓ hz s (M.step c) rt rp)
          change (rd_hostAction a b).state = (M.step c).state.map _
          rw [hstate]
          change a.state.map _ = a.state.map _
          cases ha : a.state with
          | none => rw [Option.map_none, Option.map_none]
          | some q' =>
            have hno : ¬(b = false ∧ a.inputTape = -1) := by
              intro h
              apply pause
              exact ⟨by rw [ha]; rfl, h⟩
            simp only [Option.map_some, if_neg hno]
            rw [hinput, rd_next_tag c.inputPos b hb a.inputTape hno]
        refine ⟨by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hd], by omega, ?_⟩
        intro v hv
        have hv0 : v = 0 := by omega
        rw [hv0, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hd]
        exact rd_hostFrame_layout ℓ hz _ (M.step c) rt rp
    have hcost : rd_hostCost M ℓ c = (rd_hostCost M ℓ c - 1) + 1 := by
      have := (rd_hostCost_bounds M ℓ c).1; omega
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hcost, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, first]
      exact rest.1
    · intro _ u hu
      by_cases hu0 : u = 0
      · rw [hu0, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
        simp only [rd_hostEnc, rulerHostCfg, hq, Option.map_some, ne_eq, reduceCtorEq,
          not_false_eq_true]
      · rw [show u = (u - 1) + 1 by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, first]
        exact rest.2.1 (u - 1) (by omega)
    · intro u hu
      by_cases hu0 : u = 0
      · rw [hu0, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
        exact Or.inl (rd_hostFrame_layout ℓ hz _ c rt rp)
      · rw [show u = (u - 1) + 1 by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, first]
        exact Or.inr (rest.2.2 (u - 1) (by omega))

/-- Locate every host time in a source step through the public lockstep API.

Proof sketch: for a nonzero horizon, locate within the penultimate prefix or split off
its last block. Thus a frame after the located source step is still within the horizon. -/

private theorem rd_host_frames {m : ℕ} {S : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S)
    {y z : List Bool} (ℓ : ℕ) (hz : z.length = ℓ + y.length) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ)
    (hdrop : z.drop ℓ = y) (rt : ℤ → Option Bool) (rp : ℤ)
    (hr : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (ℓ : ℤ) →
      rt (rp + p) = FinTM.bufferTape (List.replicate ℓ true) p)
    (L : Lockstep M (rd_hostTM M) (rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp) (rd_hostCost M ℓ) ∅ ∅)
    (c : Cfg m Bool S y) (t : ℕ) :
    ∀ u ≤ ∑ v ∈ Finset.range t, rd_hostCost M ℓ (M.runFrom c v),
      ∃ v ≤ t, rd_hostFrame ℓ rt rp (M.runFrom c v)
        ((rd_hostTM M).runFrom (rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp c) u) := by
  cases t with
  | zero =>
    intro u hu
    simp only [Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, Nat.le_zero] at hu
    rw [hu, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    refine ⟨0, le_rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    exact rd_hostFrame_layout ℓ hz _ c rt rp
  | succ t =>
    intro u hu
    have finish (v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ t) (w : ℕ)
        (hw : w ≤ rd_hostCost M ℓ (M.runFrom c v))
        (he : (rd_hostTM M).runFrom (rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp c) u =
          (rd_hostTM M).runFrom (rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp (M.runFrom c v)) w) :
        ∃ r ≤ t + 1, rd_hostFrame ℓ rt rp (M.runFrom c r)
          ((rd_hostTM M).runFrom (rd_hostEnc ℓ hz rt rp c) u) := by
      rw [he]
      rcases (rd_host_block M ℓ hz hℓ hdrop rt rp hr (M.runFrom c v)).2.2 w hw with h | h
      · exact ⟨v, by omega, h⟩
      · refine ⟨v + 1, by omega, ?_⟩
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
        exact h
    by_cases hp : u ≤ ∑ v ∈ Finset.range t, rd_hostCost M ℓ (M.runFrom c v)
    · obtain ⟨v, hv, w, hw, he⟩ := L.locate c t (by simp) u hp
      apply finish v hv w _ he
      rcases hw with rfl | ⟨_, hw⟩
      · omega
      · exact hw
    · let a := ∑ v ∈ Finset.range t, rd_hostCost M ℓ (M.runFrom c v)
      have ha : u = a + (u - a) := by dsimp only [a]; omega
      apply finish t le_rfl (u - a)
      · rw [Finset.sum_range_succ] at hu
        dsimp only [a]; omega
      · conv_lhs => rw [ha, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, L.runFrom c t (by simp)]

/-- **H5, the ruler host**: a positive, finite block simulation of any native-input machine on
a suffix input (the H2-S gate's finding 2). For any binary machine `M` on `m` tapes there is a
host on one more tape (the ruler, last), with a state map `inj` of the source states paired
with a boundary tag, as follows. Present a source configuration `c` on the virtual input `y`
inside `z = header ++ y` (header length `ℓ > 0`) through `Turing.rulerHostCfg`, with the ruler
`true^ℓ` at the ruler head and the tag `b` true exactly at the virtual left boundary. Then for
every `t`:
* **block endpoint**: after some `t'` host steps with `t ≤ t' ≤ C · (ℓ + 1) · t` the host
  presents the source's configuration after `t` steps, with a correct tag;
* **exit cut**: if the source is live before `t`, the host is live before `t'`;
* **intermediate frames**: at every host time up to `t'`, the bank tapes, the bank heads and
  the output are the source's at some source time no later than `t`, the ruler tape is
  unchanged, and the ruler head is on the ruler or one of its two delimiters;
* **space ledger**: the bank heads visit exactly the source's cells, and the ruler head
  `ℓ + 2` cells.

So the host halts exactly when the source does (the cut and `t ≤ t'` give the converse), with
the source's output, using the source's space plus `ℓ + 2` cells, within `C · (ℓ + 1)` times
the source's time. Literal lockstep (`t' = t`) is the native special case, and Z1's
`Turing.vhostEmitTM`. This is how H2's step block, whose input is native, runs on a suffix
input unchanged. [AB09, §1.2; Exercise 4.1]

**Proof sketch.** Each host step performs the source transition, reading the native symbol, or
blank when the tag is set, and suppressing a left move when the tag is set. A right move
clears the tag; after a left move from a cleared tag the host pauses for the boundary test of
`Turing.exists_rulerTestTM` (on the ruler tape, by R1) and sets the tag from its verdict. A
halting source transition halts the host in the same step, with no pause. The pause costs
`C · (ℓ + 1)` steps, moves no bank head, writes nothing and emits nothing, which gives the
frames and the cut. Induct on `t` as `Turing.vhostEmitTM_runFrom` does; the visited-set clauses
follow `Turing.vhostEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead_bank` and
`Turing.vhostEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead_buffer`.

**Implementation.** The host is a `Turing.Lockstep` over `Turing.rulerHostCfg` with the tag
`c.inputPos = 0`. A block costs one step, or `2ℓ + 3` after a live left move from a cleared tag:
the test runs on the last tape through `Turing.embedEmitTM` and the guarded state transport, and
its verdict resumes the source directly. Hence `C = 3`. The endpoint, the cut and the frames come
from `Turing.Lockstep.runFrom`, `.cut` and `.locate`, and the bank's visited sets are equal by
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.mem_visitedByTapeHead_iff`. -/

theorem inputRewindTM_run {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg k Bool InputRewindPhase x)
    (hstate : d.state = some .start) (hp : 1 ≤ d.inputPos.val) :
    (inputRewindTM k).runFrom d (d.inputPos.val + 1) =
        { d with state := some .done, inputPos := 1 } ∧
      (∀ t < d.inputPos.val + 1, ((inputRewindTM k).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      ∀ t ≤ d.inputPos.val + 1,
        ((inputRewindTM k).runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧
        ((inputRewindTM k).runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧
        ((inputRewindTM k).runFrom d t).output = d.output := by
  classical
  have hlt := d.inputPos.isLt
  -- the scan's trajectory
  let T : ℕ → Cfg k Bool InputRewindPhase x := fun r =>
    { d with
      state := some (if r = 0 then .start else .scan)
      inputPos := ⟨d.inputPos.val - r, by omega⟩ }
  have hT0 : T 0 = d := by
    refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ rfl rfl rfl
    · show some (if 0 = 0 then InputRewindPhase.start else .scan) = d.state
      rw [if_pos rfl, hstate]
    · refine Fin.ext ?_
      show d.inputPos.val - 0 = d.inputPos.val
      omega
  have hstep : ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ d.inputPos.val - 1 → (inputRewindTM k).step (T r) = T (r + 1) := by
    intro r hr
    have hs : (T r).state = some (if r = 0 then .start else .scan) := rfl
    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hs]
    have htr : (inputRewindTM k).tr (if r = 0 then .start else .scan) (T r).inputSymbol
        (T r).workTapeSymbols = FinTM.controlAction .neg (some .scan) := by
      by_cases hr0 : r = 0
      · rw [if_pos hr0]
        rfl
      · rw [if_neg hr0]
        have hread : (T r).inputSymbol = some (x[d.inputPos.val - r - 1]'(by omega)) := by
          refine inputSymbolInner (d.inputPos.val - r - 1) ?_ (by omega)
          show d.inputPos.val - r = 1 + (d.inputPos.val - r - 1)
          omega
        rw [hread]
        rfl
    rw [htr, FinTM.controlAction_apply]
    refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ rfl rfl rfl
    · show some InputRewindPhase.scan = some (if r + 1 = 0 then .start else .scan)
      rw [if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero r)]
    · show moveInputPos (T r).inputPos .neg = (T (r + 1)).inputPos
      rw [moveInputPos_neg_of_ne_left _ (by
        intro h
        have hv : d.inputPos.val - r = 0 := by
          have hvv := congrArg Fin.val h
          simpa [T] using hvv
        omega)]
      exact Fin.ext (by show d.inputPos.val - r - 1 = d.inputPos.val - (r + 1); omega)
  have hrun : ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ d.inputPos.val → (inputRewindTM k).runFrom d r = T r := by
    intro r hr
    induction r with
    | zero => rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hT0]
    | succ r ih =>
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega), hstep r (by omega)]
  have hfinal : (inputRewindTM k).step (T d.inputPos.val) =
      { d with state := some .done, inputPos := 1 } := by
    have hs : (T d.inputPos.val).state = some .scan := by
      show some (if d.inputPos.val = 0 then InputRewindPhase.start else .scan) = some .scan
      rw [if_neg (by omega)]
    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hs]
    have hzero : (T d.inputPos.val).inputPos = 0 := by
      refine Fin.ext ?_
      show d.inputPos.val - d.inputPos.val = (0 : Fin (x.length + 2)).val
      rw [Fin.val_zero]
      omega
    have hread : (T d.inputPos.val).inputSymbol = none := Cfg.inputSymbol_of_zero hzero
    have htr : (inputRewindTM k).tr .scan (T d.inputPos.val).inputSymbol
        (T d.inputPos.val).workTapeSymbols = FinTM.controlAction .pos (some .done) := by
      rw [hread]
      rfl
    rw [htr, FinTM.controlAction_apply]
    refine Cfg.ext rfl ?_ rfl rfl rfl
    show moveInputPos (T d.inputPos.val).inputPos .pos = (1 : Fin (x.length + 2))
    rw [hzero, moveInputPos_pos_of_ne_right (0 : Fin (x.length + 2))
      (by rw [Fin.val_zero]; omega)]
    exact Fin.ext (by simp)
  have hend : (inputRewindTM k).runFrom d (d.inputPos.val + 1) =
      { d with state := some .done, inputPos := 1 } := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', hrun d.inputPos.val le_rfl, hfinal]
  refine ⟨hend, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    rw [hrun t (by omega)]
    show some (if t = 0 then InputRewindPhase.start else .scan) ≠ some .done
    by_cases ht0 : t = 0
    · rw [if_pos ht0]; decide
    · rw [if_neg ht0]; decide
  · intro t ht
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t (d.inputPos.val + 1) with hlt' | hge
    · rw [hrun t (by omega)]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    · rw [show t = d.inputPos.val + 1 by omega, hend]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- **The park stays put**: at `done` the rewind's step changes nothing. -/

private theorem iw_one {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {z : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S)
    (c : Cfg k Bool S z) (q : S) (hc : c.state = some q) :
    M.runFrom c 1 = (M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).apply c := by
  calc
    _ = M.step (M.runFrom c 0) := MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step'
    _ = _ := by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hc]

/-- One successful copy step writes the scanned bit, advances both heads and emits nothing. -/

theorem boot_run (c : Cfg S.k Bool S.State x) (w : List Bool)
    (hlive : ∀ t < w.length, (S.tm.runFrom c t).state ≠ none) :
    (hostTM S A loop).runWith w (bootCfg (A := A) c) = bootCfg (S.tm.runFrom c w.length) := by
  induction w generalizing c with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b w ih =>
    have h0 := hlive 0 (by simp)
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero] at h0
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp h0
    rw [NDTM.runWith_cons, boot_step b c hq, ih, List.length_cons,
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step]
    intro t ht
    rw [← MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step]
    exact hlive (t + 1) (by simp; omega)

/-- The host starts in the boot configuration of `S`'s start. -/

private lemma bufferReplay_run {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool S) (q : S) (emit : Bool)
    (htr : ∀ (inp : Option Bool) (bit : Bool), tm.tr q inp (fun _ => some bit) =
      ⟨0, fun _ => (none, .pos), if emit then some bit else none, some q⟩)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (a : List Bool) : ∀ j (_hj : j ≤ a.length),
    tm.runFrom (⟨some q, p, fun _ => bufferTape a, fun _ => 0, []⟩ : Cfg 1 Bool S x) j =
      (⟨some q, p, fun _ => bufferTape a, fun _ => (j : ℤ),
        if emit then a.take j else []⟩ : Cfg 1 Bool S x) := by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro hj
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    cases emit <;> rfl
  | succ j ih =>
    intro hj
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega)]
    let c : Cfg 1 Bool S x :=
      ⟨some q, p, fun _ => bufferTape a, fun _ => (j : ℤ), if emit then a.take j else []⟩
    change tm.step c = _
    have hr : c.workTapeSymbols = fun _ => some (a[j]'(by omega)) := by
      funext i
      rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
      change bufferTape a (j : ℤ) = _
      rw [bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)]
    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some (cfg := c) rfl, hr, htr]
    refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp only [Action.apply_state]
    · simp only [Action.apply_inputPos, moveInputPos_zero, c]
    · funext i
      simp only [Action.apply_workTapes, Option.getD_none,
        Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq, Function.update_eq_self, c]
    · funext i
      simp only [Action.apply_workTapePos, c, SignType.pos_eq_one, SignType.coe_one,
        Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    · rw [Action.apply_output]
      change (if emit then a.take j else []) ++
        (if emit then some (a[j]'(by omega)) else none).toList =
          if emit then a.take (j + 1) else []
      cases emit with
      | false => rfl
      | true =>
        simp only [↓reduceIte, List.take_succ,
          List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega : j < a.length), Option.toList_some]

/-- Replay reads the buffered word once; the first-component flag decides
whether those reads emit. At the right blank the controller starts the suffix.
**Proof sketch.** Apply `bufferReplay_run` to the extractor's replay transition;
its selector chooses whether each unchanged buffer cell is emitted. -/

private lemma poly_space (d C : ℕ) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    (catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.spaceUsed
      ((catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm.initCfg x) t ≤
        (5 * (d + 1)) * (x.length + 1) := by
  let M := (catalogPolyUnaryTM d C).tm
  let c := catalogPolyCfg (c := d) (C := C) x (x.length + 1)
    (.loop (Fin.last d)) (fun _ => 0) []
  have hinv (u : ℕ) : (M.runFrom c u).workTapes =
      (fun _ => catalogPolyTape (x.length + 1)) ∧
      polyHeads (x.length + 1) (M.runFrom c u).state (M.runFrom c u).workTapePos := by
    induction u with
    | zero =>
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
      refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
      simp [c, catalogPolyCfg, polyHeads]
      omega
    | succ u ih =>
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
      exact poly_step (Nat.succ_pos _) _ ih.1 ih.2
  have hpos (u : ℕ) (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
      -(2 * (x.length + 1) : ℤ) ≤ (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) u).workTapePos i ∧
        (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) u).workTapePos i ≤ (2 * (x.length + 1) : ℤ) := by
    by_cases hu : u ≤ 2 * (x.length + 1)
    · have h := Finset.mem_Icc.mp (MultiTapeTM.workTapePos_runFrom_mem_Icc M (M.initCfg x) u i)
      have h0 : (M.initCfg x).workTapePos i = 0 := by
        rw [MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_workTapePos]
      rw [h0] at h
      constructor <;> omega
    · rw [show u = 2 * (x.length + 1) + (u - 2 * (x.length + 1)) by omega,
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, catalogPoly_start]
      have h := polyHeads_bounds (hinv (u - 2 * (x.length + 1))).2 i
      dsimp only [c, M] at h
      constructor <;> omega
  have hcard (i : Fin (d + 1)) : M.spaceUsedByTape (M.initCfg x) t i ≤
      5 * (x.length + 1) :=
    (M.spaceUsedByTape_le_card_Icc _ t i _ _ fun u _ => Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (hpos u i)).trans
      (by omega)
  change M.spaceUsed (M.initCfg x) t ≤ _
  rw [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_eq_sum]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin (d + 1), 5 * (x.length + 1) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hcard i)
    _ = _ := by simp; ring

/-- **The unary generator's time**. The generator writes `C·(|x| + 1)^e` ones within
`(C + 5e + 4)·(n + 1)^e` steps: the sharp degree `e`, not the row's `e + 1`.

**Proof sketch.** For `e = 0`, `constTM_computes` gives `C + 1 ≤ C + 4` steps. For `e = d + 1`,
today's private `catalogPoly_unary_computes d C` is exactly the bound
`(C + 5(d + 1) + 4)·(n + 1)^(d + 1)`. This replaces Catalog's `f2_unary_sharp`, whose `e = 0` case
went through a linear allowance only because it reused the constant row's existential constant. -/

private lemma fwdMapVirtual_run (M : FinTM Bool) {x y : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State y) (tag : Bool) (hb : VirtualTag c.inputPos tag)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (a pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ tag', VirtualTag (M.tm.runFrom c t).inputPos tag' ∧
      (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom (fwdMapVirtual M c tag p a pre) t =
        fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.runFrom c t) tag' p a pre := by
  let P : Set ℕ := {u | ∃ b, VirtualTag (M.tm.runFrom c u).inputPos b ∧
    (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom (fwdMapVirtual M c tag p a pre) u =
      fwdMapVirtual M (M.tm.runFrom c u) b p a pre}
  have preserve : Set.MapsTo (fun u : ℕ => u + 1) P P := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨b, hb, he⟩ := hu
    obtain ⟨b', hb', he'⟩ := fwdMapVirtual_step M _ b hb p a pre
    refine ⟨b', ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step'] using hb'
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', he, he', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
  have initial : 0 ∈ P := by
    refine ⟨tag, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero] using hb
    · simp only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
  have endpoint := preserve.iterate t initial
  change t ∈ P
  simpa only [add_right_iterate, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, zero_add] using endpoint

/-- A setup configuration is at the payload seam if its control is a
payload state; this includes the source start state on empty virtual input. -/

private lemma fwdMapSetup_stationary (M : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (c : Cfg (1 + (1 + M.k)) Bool (FwdMapState M.State) x)
    (h : fwdMapEntered M c) (t : ℕ) : (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom c t = c := by
  obtain ⟨q, tag, hs⟩ := h
  have he : (fwdMapTM M false).tm.step c = c := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.step_of_some hs]
    simp only [fwdMapTM, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
      controlAction_apply, moveInputPos_zero]
    cases c
    simp_all
  induction t with
  | zero => rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
  | succ t ih => rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih, he]

/-- Before the payload seam the operational and setup transition tables
coincide, on all configurations rather than just well-formed buffers. -/

private lemma fwdMapSetup_run (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ u < t, ¬fwdMapEntered M
      ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) u)) :
    (fwdMapTM M true).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M true).tm.initCfg x) t =
      (fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) t := by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, fwdMapTM]
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (fun u hu => h u (by omega)),
      fwdMapSetup_step M _ (h t (by omega)), MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']

/-- Every setup action leaves each payload work head fixed.

**Proof sketch.** Inspect the setup controller's phases and the possible pending bit and read
symbol. Every setup action leaves the payload-bank heads stationary, including the absorbing
setup view of the run phase. The public step and action head equations transfer that table fact
to the complete step. -/

private lemma fwdMapSetup_heads (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin M.k) :
    ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.runFrom ((fwdMapTM M false).tm.initCfg x) t).workTapePos
      (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd 1 i)) = 0 := by
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_workTapePos]
  | succ t ih => rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', fwdMapSetup_head_step, ih]

/-- Choose the first payload entry, then transfer every prefix to the
operational host. The stationary setup seam identifies this first entry
with the complete validating/buffering/emission endpoint, so no payload
work is hidden in the administrative time bound.

**Proof sketch.** The existing stationary-setup contract at one step proves that every
virtual-payload stop configuration is fixed. Apply
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.exists_first_entry_of_fixed` to that stop predicate and the bounded setup
endpoint. Guarded setup agreement then identifies every operational prefix through the returned
first entry, with the same complete endpoint and linear bound. -/

private lemma splitEmbed_cut {k : ℕ} {S H : Type} {w : List Bool}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (host : MultiTapeTM k Bool H)
    (emb : S → H) (anchor : H) (stop : S → Prop) [DecidablePred stop]
    (haway : ∀ q, emb q ≠ anchor)
    (hfix : ∀ c : Cfg k Bool S w, (∃ q, c.state = some q ∧ stop q) → tm.step c = c)
    (hagree : ∀ q, ¬stop q → ∀ inp work,
      host.tr (emb q) inp work = (tm.tr q inp work).mapState emb)
    (c d : Cfg k Bool S w) (T : ℕ)
    (hd : ∃ q, d.state = some q ∧ stop q) (hT : tm.runFrom c T = d) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, host.runFrom (c.mapState emb) t = d.mapState emb ∧
      splitSafe host anchor (c.mapState emb) t := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hcut, he⟩ :=
    MultiTapeTM.exists_first_entry_of_fixed tm stop c d T hfix hd hT
  have hp : ∀ j ≤ t, host.runFrom (c.mapState emb) j = (tm.runFrom c j).mapState emb := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro hj; simp only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega),
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
      let z := tm.runFrom c j
      change host.step (z.mapState emb) = (tm.step z).mapState emb
      cases hz : z.state with
      | none =>
        have hm : (z.mapState emb).state = none := by
          simp only [Cfg.mapState_state, hz, Option.map_none]
        rw [host.step_of_halt hm, tm.step_of_halt hz]
      | some q =>
        have hn : ¬stop q := fun hq => hcut j (by omega) ⟨q, hz, hq⟩
        have hm : (z.mapState emb).state = some (emb q) := by
          simp only [Cfg.mapState_state, hz, Option.map_some]
        have hin : (z.mapState emb).inputSymbol = z.inputSymbol := by
          have hp : (z.mapState emb).inputPos = z.inputPos := Cfg.mapState_inputPos emb z
          by_cases h0 : z.inputPos = 0
          · rw [Cfg.inputSymbol_of_zero (hp.trans h0), Cfg.inputSymbol_of_zero h0]
          · by_cases he : z.inputPos.val = w.length + 1
            · rw [Cfg.inputSymbol_of_end (by rw [hp]; exact he), Cfg.inputSymbol_of_end he]
            · have hlt := z.inputPos.isLt
              have hn : z.inputPos.val ≠ 0 := fun h => h0 (Fin.ext h)
              rw [inputSymbolInner (z.inputPos.val - 1) (by rw [hp]; omega) (by omega),
                inputSymbolInner (cfg := z) (z.inputPos.val - 1) (by omega) (by omega)]
        have hw : (z.mapState emb).workTapeSymbols = z.workTapeSymbols := by
          funext i
          rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq, Cfg.mapState_workTapes, Cfg.mapState_workTapePos,
            Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
        rw [host.step_of_some hm, tm.step_of_some hz, hin, hw, hagree q hn]
        exact Cfg.mapState_apply emb _ z
  refine ⟨t, ht, by rw [hp t (le_refl _), he], ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  rw [hp j hj]
  cases hs : (tm.runFrom c j).state with
  | none => simp [Cfg.mapState_state, hs]
  | some q => simpa [Cfg.mapState_state, hs] using haway q

/-- A standalone native-input rewind, with an absorbing return at state two. -/

theorem rewindTM_run_ofCfg {Symbol : Type*} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k)
    (u : List Symbol) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ u.length) (d : Cfg k Symbol RewindPhase x)
    (hstate : d.state = some .start)
    (hu : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p < (n : ℤ) →
      d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - n + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p) :
    (rewindTM k i).runFrom d (n + 2) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i - n) } ∧
      (∀ t < n + 2, ((rewindTM k i).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin k) (t : ℕ), t ≤ n + 2 →
        if j = i then
          ((rewindTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈
            Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - n - 1) (d.workTapePos j)
        else ((rewindTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j) := by
  let F : ℕ → Cfg k Symbol RewindPhase x := fun r =>
    rw_cfg i d (if r = 0 then .start else .back) (-(r : ℤ))
  let D : Cfg k Symbol RewindPhase x := rw_cfg i d .done (-(n : ℤ))
  have hD_eq : D = { d with
      state := some .done
      workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i - n) } := by
    simp only [D, rw_cfg, sub_eq_add_neg]
  have h0 : F 0 = d := by
    apply Cfg.ext
    · simp only [F, rw_cfg, ↓reduceIte, hstate]
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · simp only [F, rw_cfg, Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, add_zero, Function.update_eq_self]
    · rfl
  -- The head of tape `i` at `F r` reads relative position `n - r` of the word.
  have hread : ∀ r : ℕ, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ n + 1 →
      (F r).workTapeSymbols i = FinTM.bufferTape u ((n : ℤ) - r) := by
    intro r hr1 hr2
    have h := hu ((n : ℤ) - r) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [show d.workTapePos i - n + ((n : ℤ) - r) = d.workTapePos i + -(r : ℤ) by ring] at h
    rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]
    simp only [F, rw_cfg, Function.update_self]
    exact h
  have hF : ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ n → (rewindTM k i).step (F r) = F (r + 1) := by
    intro r hr
    rcases r with _ | r
    · have h := rw_step i d .start .back (-((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)) .neg rfl
      have hz : -((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) + (SignType.neg : ℤ) = -((0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
        simp only [SignType.cast]
        omega
      rw [hz] at h
      simpa only [F, if_pos rfl, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero 0)] using h
    · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, FinTM.bufferTape u ((n : ℤ) - (r + 1 : ℕ)) = some s := by
        have hlt : n - (r + 1) < u.length := by omega
        refine ⟨u[n - (r + 1)], ?_⟩
        rw [show (n : ℤ) - (r + 1 : ℕ) = ((n - (r + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) by omega,
          FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt]
      have hrd := hread (r + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [hs] at hrd
      have htr : (rewindTM k i).tr .back (F (r + 1)).inputSymbol (F (r + 1)).workTapeSymbols =
          tapeAction i 0 none .neg .back := by
        simp only [rewindTM, hrd]
      have h := rw_step i d .back .back (-((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) .neg
        (by simpa only [F, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero r)] using htr)
      have hz : -((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + (SignType.neg : ℤ) = -((r + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
        simp only [SignType.cast]
        omega
      rw [hz] at h
      simpa only [F, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero r), if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero (r + 1))] using h
  have hexit : (rewindTM k i).step (F (n + 1)) = D := by
    have hrd := hread (n + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [show (n : ℤ) - (n + 1 : ℕ) = -1 by push_cast; ring, FinTM.bufferTape_left] at hrd
    have htr : (rewindTM k i).tr .back (F (n + 1)).inputSymbol (F (n + 1)).workTapeSymbols =
        tapeAction i 0 none .pos .done := by
      simp only [rewindTM, hrd]
    have h := rw_step i d .back .done (-((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) .pos
      (by simpa only [F, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)] using htr)
    have hz : -((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + (SignType.pos : ℤ) = -(n : ℤ) := by
      simp only [SignType.cast]
      omega
    rw [hz] at h
    simpa only [F, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero n), D] using h
  -- The run follows the trace.
  have htrace : ∀ t : ℕ, t ≤ n + 1 → (rewindTM k i).runFrom d t = F t := by
    intro t ht
    induction t with
    | zero => rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, h0]
    | succ t ih =>
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega), hF t (by omega)]
  have hend : (rewindTM k i).runFrom d (n + 2) = D := by
    rw [show n + 2 = (n + 1) + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step',
      htrace (n + 1) le_rfl, hexit]
  refine ⟨hend.trans hD_eq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    rw [htrace t (by omega)]
    simp only [F, rw_cfg]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  · intro j t ht
    have hpos : ∃ z : ℤ, -(n : ℤ) - 1 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ 0 ∧
        ((rewindTM k i).runFrom d t).workTapePos =
          Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + z) := by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t (n + 2) with hlt | hge
      · refine ⟨-(t : ℤ), by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
        rw [htrace t (by omega)]
        simp only [F, rw_cfg]
      · refine ⟨-(n : ℤ), by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
        rw [show t = n + 2 by omega, hend]
        simp only [D, rw_cfg]
    obtain ⟨z, hz1, hz2, hz⟩ := hpos
    rw [hz]
    split_ifs with hj
    · subst hj
      simp only [Function.update_self, Finset.mem_Icc]
      constructor <;> omega
    · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hj]

end Turing

private theorem sl_unarySplit_copy {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src sm : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ sm)
    (q : ℕ) (d : Cfg k Bool sl_SplitPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .copy)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ q →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = some (decide (p < q))) :
    (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d (q + 1) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapes := Function.update (Function.update d.workTapes src
              (Function.update (d.workTapes src) (d.workTapePos src + q) none)) sm
            (fun z => if d.workTapePos sm ≤ z ∧ z ≤ d.workTapePos sm + q
              then some (decide (z < d.workTapePos sm + q)) else d.workTapes sm z)
          workTapePos := Function.update (Function.update d.workTapePos src
            (d.workTapePos src + q + 1)) sm (d.workTapePos sm + q) } ∧
      (∀ t < q + 1, ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      ∀ t ≤ q + 1, ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d t).output = d.output := by
  induction q generalizing d with
  | zero =>
    have h0 := hw 0 le_rfl
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, decide_eq_false (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)] at h0
    have hs := sl_split_step_exit src sm hne hstate
      (by rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]; exact h0)
    have hrun1 : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d 1 = (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d := by
      rw [show (1 : ℕ) = 0 + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [show ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 0 from by norm_num, hrun1, hs]
      apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only <;> try rfl
      · funext j
        rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
        · simp only [Function.update_self]
          funext z
          rcases eq_or_ne z (d.workTapePos j) with rfl | hz
          · rw [Function.update_self, if_pos (by omega)]
            congr 1
            symm
            rw [decide_eq_false_iff_not]
            omega
          · rw [Function.update_of_ne hz, if_neg (by omega)]
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
          rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
          · simp only [Function.update_self, add_zero]
          · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc]
      · funext j
        rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
        · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hne), add_zero]
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
          rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
          · simp only [Function.update_self, add_zero]
          · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc]
    · intro t ht
      rcases t with _ | t
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hstate]
        simp
      · omega
    · intro t ht
      rcases t with _ | t
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
      · rcases t with _ | t
        · rw [hrun1, hs]
        · omega
  | succ q ih =>
    have h0 := hw 0 (by omega)
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, decide_eq_true (by omega : 0 < q + 1)] at h0
    have hs := sl_split_step_true src sm hne hstate
      (by rw [Cfg.workTapeSymbols_eq]; exact h0)
    have hw₁ : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ q →
        ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d).workTapes src
          (((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d).workTapePos src + p) =
          some (decide (p < q)) := by
      intro p hp
      rw [hs]
      dsimp only
      rw [Function.update_of_ne hne, Function.update_of_ne hne, Function.update_self]
      have h := hw (1 + p) (by omega)
      rw [show (d.workTapePos src + ((1 + p : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
          d.workTapePos src + 1 + (p : ℕ) from by
        push_cast; ring, show decide (1 + p < q + 1) = decide (p < q) from by
        rw [decide_eq_decide]; omega] at h
      exact h
    obtain ⟨ihrun, ihcut, ihout⟩ := ih ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d) (by rw [hs]) hw₁
    have hstep1 : ∀ t : ℕ, (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d (t + 1) =
        (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d) t := fun t =>
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hstep1 (q + 1), ihrun, hs]
      apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only <;> try rfl
      · funext j
        rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
        · simp only [Function.update_self]
          funext z
          by_cases hz1 : d.workTapePos j + 1 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ d.workTapePos j + 1 + (q : ℕ)
          · rw [if_pos hz1, if_pos (by omega)]
            congr 1
            rw [decide_eq_decide]
            omega
          · rw [if_neg hz1]
            by_cases hz0 : z = d.workTapePos j
            · subst hz0
              rw [Function.update_self, if_pos (by omega)]
              congr 1
              symm
              rw [decide_eq_true_eq]
              omega
            · rw [Function.update_of_ne hz0, if_neg (by omega)]
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
          rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
          · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
            congr 1
            push_cast
            ring
          · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
      · funext j
        rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
        · simp only [Function.update_self]
          push_cast
          ring
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
          rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
          · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
            push_cast
            ring
          · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
    · intro t ht
      rcases t with _ | t
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hstate]
        simp
      · rw [hstep1 t]
        exact ihcut t (by omega)
    · intro t ht
      rcases t with _ | t
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
      · rw [hstep1 t, ihout t (by omega), hs]

/-- **The unary-split leaf, framed.** From any configuration in `mv1` whose tape `src` holds the
unary word `1^q 0` from its head, the leaf reaches `done` at exactly `q + 3` and not earlier,
with the word written on `sm` from two cells right of that tape's head (that head ends on the
written terminator), the terminator's cell of `src` blanked and its head one cell past it, and
everything else — every other cell, every other head, the input position and the output —
unchanged. The output is unchanged at every time up to the exit.

**Proof sketch.** Two offset moves of the head of `sm` (`sl_step_move`), which leave `src`
untouched, then the copying loop (`sl_unarySplit_copy`) from the shifted summary head. Compose at
time `2` and collect the fields. -/

private theorem sl_unarySplitTM_run {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (src sm : Fin k) (hne : src ≠ sm)
    (q : ℕ) (d : Cfg k Bool sl_SplitPhase x) (hstate : d.state = some .mv1)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ q →
      d.workTapes src (d.workTapePos src + p) = some (decide (p < q))) :
    (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d (q + 3) =
        { d with
          state := some .done
          workTapes := Function.update (Function.update d.workTapes src
              (Function.update (d.workTapes src) (d.workTapePos src + q) none)) sm
            (fun z => if d.workTapePos sm + 2 ≤ z ∧ z ≤ d.workTapePos sm + 2 + q
              then some (decide (z < d.workTapePos sm + 2 + q)) else d.workTapes sm z)
          workTapePos := Function.update (Function.update d.workTapePos src
            (d.workTapePos src + q + 1)) sm (d.workTapePos sm + 2 + q) } ∧
      (∀ t < q + 3, ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d t).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      ∀ t ≤ q + 3, ((sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d t).output = d.output := by
  have hs1 : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step d =
      { d with
        state := some .mv2
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 1) } :=
    sl_step_move _ sm hstate _ (by simp only [sl_unarySplitTM])
  have hs2 : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).step { d with
      state := some sl_SplitPhase.mv2
      workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 1) } =
      { d with
        state := some .copy
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 2) } := by
    refine (sl_step_move (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm) sm
      (c := { d with
        state := some sl_SplitPhase.mv2
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 1) })
      rfl .copy (by simp only [sl_unarySplitTM])).trans ?_
    apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only
    rw [Function.update_idem, Function.update_self]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hrun1 : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d 1 =
      { d with
        state := some .mv2
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 1) } := by
    rw [show (1 : ℕ) = 0 + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one, hs1]
  have hrun2 : (sl_unarySplitTM k src sm).runFrom d 2 =
      { d with
        state := some .copy
        workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 2) } := by
    rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 from rfl, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', hrun1, hs2]
  have hw₂ : ∀ p : ℕ, p ≤ q →
      ({ d with
          state := some sl_SplitPhase.copy
          workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 2) } :
        Cfg k Bool sl_SplitPhase x).workTapes src
        (({ d with
            state := some sl_SplitPhase.copy
            workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos sm (d.workTapePos sm + 2) } :
          Cfg k Bool sl_SplitPhase x).workTapePos src + p) = some (decide (p < q)) := by
    intro p hp
    dsimp only
    rw [Function.update_of_ne hne]
    exact hw p hp
  obtain ⟨crun, ccut, cout⟩ := sl_unarySplit_copy src sm hne q _ rfl hw₂
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [show q + 3 = 2 + (q + 1) from by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun2, crun]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> dsimp only <;> try rfl
    · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hne]
    · funext j
      rcases eq_or_ne j sm with rfl | hjsm
      · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hne]
      · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
        rcases eq_or_ne j src with rfl | hjsrc
        · simp only [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
        · simp only [Function.update_of_ne hjsrc, Function.update_of_ne hjsm]
  · intro t ht
    rcases t with _ | _ | t
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hstate]
      simp
    · rw [hrun1]
      simp
    · rw [show t + 1 + 1 = 2 + t from by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun2]
      exact ccut t (by omega)
  · intro t ht
    rcases t with _ | _ | t
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
    · rw [hrun1]
    · rw [show t + 1 + 1 = 2 + t from by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun2]
      exact cout t (by omega)

/-! ### Private layer: the word identities

The source word `s = pairEncode a (1^q 0 ++ v)` splits as the header `pairEncode a []`, the
unary field and the table field; its cells are read through `Turing.pairEncode_eq` and the
published `Turing.FinTM.bufferTape` identities only. -/

/-- The unary word's cells at an integer index: `true` strictly below `q`, `false` at `q`. -/

theorem roundTM_iterate {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (t : ℕ) : ∀ (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x),
    (∀ u ≤ t, (M.runFrom c u).state.isSome) →
    ∀ (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x),
    d.state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ → Rep M.tr c d →
    ∃ T, t ≤ T ∧ T ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1)) ∧
      ((roundTM k).runFrom d T).state = some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ ∧
      Rep M.tr (M.runFrom c t) ((roundTM k).runFrom d T) ∧
      (∀ u ≤ T, ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).output = d.output ∧
        ((roundTM k).runFrom d u).state ≠ some ⟨.halt, ()⟩) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin k, (roundTM k).visitedByTapeHead d T (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ⊆
        M.visitedByTapeHead c t i) ∧
      ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val → (roundTM k).visitedByTapeHead d T j ⊆
        Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ))
          ((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
  have entry_ne_halt : (some ⟨.entry, ()⟩ : Option (Σ key, Ph k key)) ≠
      some ⟨.halt, ()⟩ := by
    intro h
    cases (Sigma.mk.inj (Option.some.inj h)).1
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    intro c _ d hd rel
    refine ⟨0, le_rfl, Nat.zero_le _, hd, rel, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro u hu
      have hu0 : u = 0 := by omega
      subst hu0
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hd]
      exact ⟨rfl, entry_ne_halt⟩
    · intro i p hp
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range] at hp ⊢
      obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hp
      have hu0 : u = 0 := by omega
      subst hu0
      exact ⟨0, by omega, by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero,
        (rel.2.1 i).2]⟩
    · intro j hj p hp
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range] at hp
      obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hp
      have hu0 : u = 0 := by omega
      subst hu0
      have h0 : d.workTapePos j = 0 := by
        have hjv : j.val = k ∨ j.val = k + 1 := by omega
        rcases hjv with h | h
        · have : j = tableTape k := Fin.ext (by simpa [tableTape] using h)
          rw [this]; exact rel.2.2.2.2.1
        · have : j = summaryTape k := Fin.ext (by simpa [summaryTape] using h)
          rw [this]; exact rel.2.2.2.2.2
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, h0, Finset.mem_Icc]
      omega
  | succ t ih =>
    intro c hlive d hd rel
    have hc := hlive 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero] at hc
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hc
    have hstep : M.step c = (M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).apply c := by
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, hq]
    obtain ⟨T₁, hpos, hT₁, hexit, hrel, hcut, hsil, hvis, haux⟩ :=
      roundTM_visited M.tr c q hq d hd rel
    have hlive' : ∀ u ≤ t, (M.runFrom (M.step c) u).state.isSome := by
      intro u hu
      rw [← MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step]
      exact hlive (u + 1) (by omega)
    have hsucc : (M.tr q c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols).state.isSome := by
      have h1 := hlive' 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
      rwa [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hstep] at h1
    rw [hsucc] at hexit
    rw [← hstep] at hrel hvis
    obtain ⟨T₂, hlow, hT₂, hent, hrel₂, hrest, hvis₂, haux₂⟩ :=
      ih (M.step c) hlive' _ hexit hrel
    refine ⟨T₁ + T₂, by omega, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Nat.succ_mul]; omega
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add]; exact hent
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add (tm := roundTM k) d T₁ T₂,
        MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step (tm := M)]
      exact hrel₂
    · intro u hu
      by_cases hle : u ≤ T₁
      · refine ⟨hsil u hle, ?_⟩
        by_cases h0 : u = 0
        · subst h0
          rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hd]
          exact entry_ne_halt
        · by_cases hT : u = T₁
          · subst hT
            rw [hexit]
            exact entry_ne_halt
          · obtain ⟨s, hs, -, hh⟩ := hcut u (by omega) (by omega)
            rw [hs]
            exact fun h => hh (Option.some.inj h)
      · obtain ⟨hout, hhalt⟩ := hrest (u - T₁) (by omega)
        have hu' : u = T₁ + (u - T₁) := by omega
        rw [hu', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add]
        refine ⟨?_, hhalt⟩
        rw [hout]
        exact hsil T₁ le_rfl
    · intro i p hp
      have hsplit :=
        MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead_add_subset (roundTM k) d T₁ T₂ (Fin.castAdd 2 i) hp
      have hshift := MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead_step_subset M c t i
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hsplit with h | h
      · have h' := hvis i h
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h'
        rcases h' with rfl | rfl
        · exact hshift (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
        · apply hshift
          apply Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
          simp only [MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
          exact ⟨0, by omega, by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]⟩
      · exact hshift (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (hvis₂ i h))
    · intro j hj p hp
      have hsplit := MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead_add_subset (roundTM k) d T₁ T₂ j hp
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hsplit with h | h
      · exact haux j hj h
      · exact haux₂ j hj h

/-- **The round time is the unique first positive exit** (additive). Under the contract's
hypotheses there is exactly one time `T` such that `0 < T`, the block is at `entry` or at
`halt` at time `T`, and it is at neither exit at any time strictly between `0` and `T`. Hence
the existential time of `roundTM_effect` is this `T`, whichever witness is chosen, and a host
may define its round-time function by choice or by `Nat.find` without ambiguity (design note
O7; counter-loop round functions; MIG-0b's round time).

**Proof sketch.** Existence: the contract's time is positive, its endpoint is at
`exit k a.state.isSome`, which is `entry` or `halt`, and its cut keeps every strictly earlier
positive time off both exits. Uniqueness: of two such times, the smaller would lie strictly
between `0` and the larger, where the larger one's cut forbids both exits. -/

theorem exists_forwardLoopTM (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (L : MultiTapeTM (k + 2) Bool Q)
      (entry : Q) (C : ℕ),
      ∀ {n : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))),
        ∃ cost : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x → ℕ,
          Lockstep M L (forwardLoopCfg entry M) cost {none} {none} ∧
          (∀ c, c.state ≠ none → 0 < cost c ∧
            cost c ≤ 50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C) ∧
          ∀ (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (t : ℕ), (∀ u < t, (M.runFrom c u).state ≠ none) →
            (∀ i : Fin k, L.visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg entry M c)
                (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, cost (M.runFrom c u)) (Fin.castAdd 2 i) ⊆
              M.visitedByTapeHead c t i) ∧
            ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), k ≤ j.val →
              L.visitedByTapeHead (forwardLoopCfg entry M c)
                  (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, cost (M.runFrom c u)) j ⊆
                Finset.Icc (-((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C : ℕ) : ℤ))
                  ((50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1) + C : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
  classical
  refine ⟨(Σ b, fl_Ph k b), inferInstance, inferInstance, fl_TM k, fl_entry k, 3, ?_⟩
  intro n x M
  let cost (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) : ℕ :=
    if h : c.state ≠ none then (fl_step_exists M c h).choose else 1
  have chosen (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (h : c.state ≠ none) :
      cost c = (fl_step_exists M c h).choose := dif_pos h
  have one (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x) (h : c.state ≠ none) :=
    (fl_step_exists M c h).choose_spec
  have lock : Lockstep M (fl_TM k) (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M) cost {none} {none} := by
    constructor
    · intro c h
      have alive : c.state ≠ none := by simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using h
      rw [chosen c alive]
      exact (one c alive).2.2.1
    · intro c h
      simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h ⊢
      simp [forwardLoopCfg, h]
    · intro c h u hu
      have alive : c.state ≠ none := by simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using h
      rw [chosen c alive] at hu
      exact (one c alive).2.2.2.1 u hu
  refine ⟨cost, lock, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro c h
    rw [chosen c h]
    exact ⟨(one c h).1, (one c h).2.1⟩
  · intro c t ht
    constructor
    · -- Split visited sets at each completed round; the lockstep supplies its start.
      induction t with
      | zero => simp [MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead, forwardLoopCfg]
      | succ t ih =>
        have ht' : ∀ u < t, (M.runFrom c u).state ≠ none := fun u hu => ht u (by omega)
        have alive := ht t (by omega)
        have atRound := lock.runFrom c t ht'
        intro i p hp
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ] at hp
        have split := MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead_add_subset (fl_TM k)
          (forwardLoopCfg (fl_entry k) M c)
          (∑ u ∈ Finset.range t, cost (M.runFrom c u)) (cost (M.runFrom c t))
          (Fin.castAdd 2 i) hp
        rcases Finset.mem_union.mp split with before | current
        · have old := ih ht' i before
          exact (Finset.image_subset_image (Finset.range_mono (Nat.le_succ (t + 1)))) old
        · rw [atRound, chosen (M.runFrom c t) alive] at current
          have h := (one (M.runFrom c t) alive).2.2.2.2.1 i current
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp h with rfl | hend
          · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨t, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), rfl⟩
          · have heq := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hend
            apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
            refine ⟨t + 1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), ?_⟩
            simpa only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step'] using heq.symm
    · -- Locate an auxiliary-head visit in one round, or at an encoded start.
      intro j hj p hp
      obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      obtain ⟨u, _, w, hw, run⟩ := lock.locate c t ht v
        (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hv))
      rw [run]
      rcases hw with rfl | ⟨alive, hw⟩
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, fl_home (fl_entry k) M (M.runFrom c u) j hj]
        exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨neg_nonpos.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _), Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩
      · rw [chosen (M.runFrom c u) alive] at hw
        exact (one (M.runFrom c u) alive).2.2.2.2.2 j hj
          (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨w, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr hw), rfl⟩)

end StepBlock

private lemma loopOrbit_rep {k n : ℕ} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1))) (c : Cfg k Bool (Fin (n + 1)) x)
    (start : c.state ≠ none) (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some (exit k true)) (rel : Rep M.tr c d)
    (r : ℕ) (live : ∀ u < r, (M.runFrom c u).state ≠ none) :
    let e := counterLoopOrbit (roundTM k) loopRoundTime d r
    e.state = some (exit k (M.runFrom c r).state.isSome) ∧
      Rep M.tr (M.runFrom c r) e ∧ e.output = d.output := by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    dsimp only
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mpr start]
    exact ⟨entry, rel, rfl⟩
  | succ r ih =>
    obtain ⟨state, related, output⟩ := ih (fun u hu => live u (by omega))
    have alive := live r (by omega)
    have anchor :
        (counterLoopOrbit (roundTM k) loopRoundTime d r).state = some (exit k true) := by
      simpa only [Option.isSome_iff_ne_none.mpr alive] using state
    obtain ⟨_, _, hs, hr, ho, _⟩ := loopRoundTime_spec M (M.runFrom c r) alive
      (counterLoopOrbit (roundTM k) loopRoundTime d r) anchor related
    dsimp only
    rw [loopOrbit_succ, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
    exact ⟨hs, hr, ho.trans output⟩

/-- **A live round** (formerly `h1Clock_round`, generalized to any start `c`): while the source
is live up to step `r`, the loop's round `r` starts at the anchor and lasts a positive time at
most `50·(|tableBitsK M.tr| + 1)`, strictly inside which the block is at neither exit.

**Proof sketch.** The orbit invariant at `r` puts the orbit at the anchor, the source being
live at `r`; the round index's specification at that live represented configuration gives the
positive bounded time and the cut. -/

private theorem sc_rounds {k : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} [DecidableEq Γ] (e : Bool ↪ Γ)
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Γ S) (stopAt : S → Bool) {x : List Γ} (c : Cfg k Γ S x) (q : S)
    (hq : c.state = some q) (w : List Bool) (ct : ℤ → Option Γ) (cp : ℤ)
    (hw : ∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ (w.length : ℤ) → ct (cp + p) = FinTM.bufferTape (w.map e) p)
    (n : ℕ) (budget : n ≤ Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat))
    (before : ∀ v < n, ¬(M.runFrom c v).Stopped stopAt) :
    let H := sc_clockTM e M stopAt
    let a := clockCfg (some (sc_State.dec q .run)) c ct cp
    H.runFrom a (counterOverhead w n + n) =
        clockCfg (some (sc_resume (M.runFrom c n).state)) (M.runFrom c n)
          (wordPatch ct cp ((counterWord w n).map e)) cp ∧
      Segment H sc_exits
        (fun p => p (Fin.last k) ∈ Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + (w.length : ℤ))) a
        (clockCfg (some (sc_resume (M.runFrom c n).state)) (M.runFrom c n)
          (wordPatch ct cp ((counterWord w n).map e)) cp) (counterOverhead w n + n) ∧
      ∀ u ≤ counterOverhead w n + n, ∃ v ≤ n, ∃ z tape head,
        H.runFrom a u = clockCfg z (M.runFrom c v) tape head ∧
          head ∈ Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + (w.length : ℤ)) := by
  intro H a
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have initial := sc_wordPatch_self ct cp (w.map e) (by simpa using hw)
    rw [counterOverhead_zero, counterWord_zero]
    simp only [Nat.zero_add, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hq, sc_resume, initial]
    refine ⟨rfl, Segment.zero ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [a, clockCfg, Finset.mem_Icc]
    · intro u hu
      obtain rfl : u = 0 := by omega
      exact ⟨0, le_rfl, some (.dec q .run), ct, cp, rfl, by simp [Finset.mem_Icc]⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨reached, segment, trace⟩ := ih (by omega) (fun v hv => before v (by omega))
    obtain ⟨s, state, flag⟩ := sc_live stopAt (M.runFrom c n) (before n (by omega))
    simp only [state, sc_resume] at reached segment
    have wordNext := counter_word_decrement w n (by omega)
    have delimited := sc_wordPatch_frame ct cp (w.map e) ((counterWord w n).map e)
      (by simp only [List.length_map, counterWord_length]) (by simpa using hw)
    obtain ⟨debit, debitSegment, debitTrace⟩ := sc_clockDebit e M stopAt (M.runFrom c n) s flag
      (counterWord w n) (wordPatch ct cp ((counterWord w n).map e)) cp (by simpa using delimited)
    have overwrite := sc_wordPatch_twice ct cp ((counterWord w n).map e)
      ((counterWord w (n + 1)).map e) (by simp only [List.length_map, counterWord_length])
    simp only [wordNext, Option.isSome_some, Option.getD_some, sc_decExit, overwrite,
      counterWord_length] at debit debitSegment
    simp only [counterWord_length] at debitTrace
    let middle := clockCfg (some (sc_State.body s)) (M.runFrom c n)
      (wordPatch ct cp ((counterWord w (n + 1)).map e)) cp
    have action : H.step middle =
        clockCfg (some (sc_resume (M.runFrom c (n + 1)).state)) (M.runFrom c (n + 1))
          (wordPatch ct cp ((counterWord w (n + 1)).map e)) cp := by
      simpa only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', sc_resume] using
        sc_body_step e M stopAt (M.runFrom c n) s state
          (wordPatch ct cp ((counterWord w (n + 1)).map e)) cp
    have bodySegment := Segment.one (M := H) (F := sc_exits)
      (P := fun p => p (Fin.last k) ∈ Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + (w.length : ℤ)))
      (a := middle) (by rintro ⟨r, h⟩; simp [middle, clockCfg] at h)
      (by simp [middle, clockCfg, Finset.mem_Icc])
      (by rw [action]; simp [clockCfg, Finset.mem_Icc])
    rw [action] at bodySegment
    have combined := segment.trans (debitSegment.trans bodySegment)
    have time : counterOverhead w (n + 1) + (n + 1) = counterOverhead w n + n +
        ((2 * ((counterWord w n).takeWhile not).length + 2) + 1) := by
      rw [counterOverhead_succ]
      omega
    rw [time]
    refine ⟨?_, combined, ?_⟩
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, reached, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, debit]
      exact action
    · intro u hu
      by_cases old : u ≤ counterOverhead w n + n
      · obtain ⟨v, hv, z, tape, head, seen, bound⟩ := trace u old
        exact ⟨v, by omega, z, tape, head, seen, bound⟩
      · have splitTime : u = counterOverhead w n + n + (u - (counterOverhead w n + n)) := by
          omega
        rw [splitTime, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, reached]
        by_cases during : u - (counterOverhead w n + n) ≤
            2 * ((counterWord w n).takeWhile not).length + 2
        · obtain ⟨seen, bound⟩ := debitTrace _ during
          exact ⟨n, by omega, _, _, _, seen, bound⟩
        · have last : u - (counterOverhead w n + n) =
              (2 * ((counterWord w n).takeWhile not).length + 2) + 1 := by omega
          rw [last, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, debit]
          change ∃ v ≤ n + 1, ∃ z tape head,
            H.step middle = clockCfg z (M.runFrom c v) tape head ∧ _
          rw [action]
          exact ⟨n + 1, le_rfl, _, _, cp, rfl, by simp [Finset.mem_Icc]⟩

/-- Package an exit segment and its joint trajectory into the headline's concrete clauses.

**Proof sketch.** First-exit uniqueness supplies the cut without unfolding `Segment`.
Read the body fields from each observed clock configuration, keeping the same source time
for every field. The endpoint word and the time bound are supplied by the caller. -/

theorem vhostEmitTM_runFrom (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (c : Cfg m Bool S y)
    (b : Bool) (hb : FinTM.VirtualTag c.inputPos b) (p : Fin (x.length + 2))
    (pre : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ b', FinTM.VirtualTag (M.runFrom c t).inputPos b' ∧
      (vhostEmitTM M).runFrom (vhostCfg c b p pre) t =
        vhostCfg (M.runFrom c t) b' p pre := by
  let P : Set ℕ := {u | ∃ tag, FinTM.VirtualTag (M.runFrom c u).inputPos tag ∧
    (vhostEmitTM M).runFrom (vhostCfg c b p pre) u =
      vhostCfg (M.runFrom c u) tag p pre}
  have preserve : Set.MapsTo (fun u : ℕ => u + 1) P P := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨tag, htag, he⟩ := hu
    obtain ⟨tag', htag', he'⟩ := vhostEmitTM_step M _ tag htag p pre
    refine ⟨tag', ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step'] using htag'
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', he, he', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
  have initial : 0 ∈ P := by
    refine ⟨b, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero] using hb
    · simp only [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
  have endpoint := preserve.iterate t initial
  change t ∈ P
  simpa only [add_right_iterate, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, zero_add] using endpoint

/-- Bank tape `i` of the forwarding host visits exactly the cells the
source's tape `i` visits, at every horizon.

**Proof sketch.** Project `vhostEmitTM_runFrom` at each time
`u ≤ t` onto the head of `vhostBank i`: the transported configuration
holds the source head verbatim, so the two `Finset.image`s over
`Finset.range (t + 1)` agree pointwise. -/

theorem windowRun_spec {k : ℕ} {Q T : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (s : ℕ) (upd : T → Option Bool → T) :
    ∀ (N : ℕ) (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (τ : T), c.InWindow s →
      ∃ r ≤ N, (windowRun M s upd N c τ).2.1 = M.runFrom c r ∧
        (∀ u ≤ r, (M.runFrom c u).InWindow s) ∧
        (∀ u < r, (M.runFrom c u).state ≠ none) ∧
        ((windowRun M s upd N c τ).1 = .halted → r < N ∧ (M.runFrom c r).state = none) ∧
        ((windowRun M s upd N c τ).1 = .left → r < N ∧ (M.runFrom c r).state ≠ none ∧
          ¬(M.runFrom c (r + 1)).InWindow s) ∧
        ((windowRun M s upd N c τ).1 = .exhausted → r = N) := by
  intro N
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    intro c τ hc
    refine ⟨0, le_rfl, by simp [windowRun], ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro u hu
      rw [show u = 0 by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
      exact hc
    · intro u hu
      omega
    · simp [windowRun]
    · simp [windowRun]
    · intro _
      rfl
  | succ N ih =>
    intro c τ hc
    by_cases hst : c.state = none
    · refine ⟨0, by omega, by simp [windowRun, hst], ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro u hu
        rw [show u = 0 by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
        exact hc
      · intro u hu
        omega
      · intro _
        exact ⟨by omega, by simpa using hst⟩
      · simp [windowRun, hst]
      · simp [windowRun, hst]
    · by_cases hw : (M.step c).InWindow s
      · have heq : windowRun M s upd (N + 1) c τ =
            windowRun M s upd N (M.step c) (upd τ (M.outputSymbol c)) := by
          simp only [windowRun, if_neg hst, if_pos hw]
        obtain ⟨r, hr, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := ih (M.step c) (upd τ (M.outputSymbol c)) hw
        rw [heq]
        refine ⟨r + 1, by omega, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [h1, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step]
        · intro u hu
          cases u with
          | zero => simpa using hc
          | succ u =>
            rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step]
            exact h2 u (by omega)
        · intro u hu
          cases u with
          | zero => simpa using hst
          | succ u =>
            rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step]
            exact h3 u (by omega)
        · intro h
          obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := h4 h
          exact ⟨by omega, by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step]; exact b⟩
        · intro h
          obtain ⟨a, b, e⟩ := h5 h
          refine ⟨by omega, by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step]; exact b, ?_⟩
          rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step]
          exact e
        · intro h
          have := h6 h
          omega
      · refine ⟨0, by omega, by simp [windowRun, hst, hw], ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro u hu
          rw [show u = 0 by omega, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
          exact hc
        · intro u hu
          omega
        · simp [windowRun, hst, hw]
        · intro _
          refine ⟨by omega, by simpa using hst, ?_⟩
          simpa [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step] using hw
        · simp [windowRun, hst, hw]

/-- **The tag tracks the output.** If the tag `σ` of output words is compatible with `upd`
and the run starts with the tag of `c`'s output, the reported tag is the tag of the reported
configuration's output, at every exit. No output word is buffered (design §12.8a, W1).

**Proof sketch.** Induct on `N`; at a step the new tag is `σ` of the appended output. -/

theorem MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one {k : ℕ} {Γ S : Type*} {x : List Γ}
    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Γ S) (c : Cfg k Γ S x) : tm.runFrom c 1 = tm.step c := by
  rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]

/-- **The input read depends on the input head only.** Two configurations on the same input,
of machines with any numbers of work tapes and any states, read the same input symbol when their
input heads are at the same position.

**Proof sketch.** At position `0` and at `|input| + 1` both read blank
(`Turing.Cfg.inputSymbol_of_zero`, `Turing.Cfg.inputSymbol_of_end`); at an inner position `1 + p`
both read `input[p]` (`Turing.inputSymbolInner`). -/

private lemma summaryClock_correct {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q)
    {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (t : ℕ) :
    summaryClock M t c (outputSummary c.output) =
      ((M.runFrom c t).state.isNone &&
        (outputSummary (M.runFrom c t).output == some true)) := by
  induction t generalizing c <;>
    simp only [summaryClock, ← outputSummary_append, ← MultiTapeTM.step_output,
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, *]

/-- Inspecting the semantic clock at the deadline is exactly bounded acceptance,
including a halt on the last permitted transition. -/

lemma visitedByTapeHead_step_subset {m : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (c : Cfg m Bool S x) (t : ℕ) (j : Fin m) :
    insert (c.workTapePos j) (M.visitedByTapeHead (M.step c) t j) ⊆
      M.visitedByTapeHead c (t + 1) j := by
  intro p hp
  simp only [MultiTapeTM.visitedByTapeHead, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_image,
    Finset.mem_range] at hp ⊢
  rcases hp with rfl | ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨0, by omega, by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]⟩
  · exact ⟨v + 1, by omega, by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step]⟩
